path: /Technology & Software/2. Targit/2.5 Installation/2.5.3 If TARGIT Client is Showing the Wrong Date Format
content:
The date formats shown in TARGIT depends on the regional/culture settings of the service running the TARGIT server (ANTServer). In our setup, we have a specific service account that runs the TARGIT server, and to check the settings of this account, you should start a Power Shell prompt by selecting "Run as different user" and type in the credentials of the service account.

To get the current culture settings, type "Get-Culture" and ENTER:

![image.png](/.attachments/image-07c360a1-6914-4d88-975c-c5889002088c.png)

If "Name" is "en-US" instead of "da-DK" (as shown above) and you want Danish date formats in TARGIT, you should run this command:

"Set-Culture -cultureinfo  da-DK" and ENTER.

You can't run "Get-Culture" afterwards and verify the changes, you have to close Power Shell and run it again, selecting "Run as different user" and type in the credentials of the service account and run the command "Get-Culture" and then you can see the changes made.

After this is done, date formats in TARGIT client should be in Danish format.

path: /Products & Services/STAR - STAR/5. Other/5.1 SUP data delivery from STAR/5.1.2 Joblog
content:
## Introduction

Detail information about the project can be found [here](https://kmddk.sharepoint.com/:f:/s/Dima-365/Er4RDOMqFU9Gi4kayUBzk7sBVuVYFQtOc9OpZ4hKq8q3zQ?e=4JhrpE).

File with questions and answers to SUP about the joblog: [link](https://kmddk.sharepoint.com/:w:/s/Dima-365/EQaLpHx7YiZLgAUCmNOt1AUBPeb3EsHTPmkxE3AQUwW4gA?e=J1LaRc).

### Data

Data is shared on the SFTP server, in form of CSV files (packed in zip repositories). For now (03-03-2023) after logging to SFTP we can Subfolders with Data Ranges are named with an assigned 2-digit code that is used as cross-identification as a link to SUP documentation. Under each Data Areas are 2 folders, one with "Delta" deliveries, one with one set of "Full" deliveries. Joblog is under directory 09. 

After KMD obtain more municipalities root directory after logging will be changed, so at first there will be directories with 3-digit municipality numbers.

Data is delivered in two ways - full and delta. Full deliveries take place one a month, each delivery contains all existing data. Delta deliveries should be taking place once a week but for now (written 03-03-2023), regarding to problems with data quality, delta deliveries are not used. 

Both in full and delta deliveries there are files with same names and with or without TILFLYNING at the end. In the TILFLYNING files there is history from previous municipality of Citizens, who has just moved in to the current one. Also there are files with History in their names, the are not currently used.

More details about History in the deliveries can be found [here](https://kmddk.sharepoint.com/:w:/s/Dima-365/EZ99fD524g5KktbQ4qvy_WoBd9PjmThr4fEL-zOFN7EK-w?e=DgAA9t).

Data in source files is delimited with ¤|¤|¤ symbols, some fields contain "" symbol, there are no text quantifiers. Additionally in one of the files there was a CRLF indicating row break in the middle of the record. Due to this problem there is a addtional step in powershell scripts - field delimiter and row delimiter are changed, "" is swapped to '', text quantifiers are added. Files in this form are loaded to DSA.


### Authorizations

Credentials required to connect to the SFTP Server are saved on the [SecretServer](https://passwords.kmd.dk/SecretServer/login.aspx?ReturnUrl=%2FSecretServer%2Fapp%2F%23%2F).


## Modules

List of modules which are contained in the solution:
| Module name | Backend developer | Product owner | Type |
|--|--|--|--|
| 001_dsa_joblog  | MJL, PYO | SRA |Product   |
| 001_dataarea_joblog  | MJL, PYO | SRA |  Product |
| 001_dsa_codelist | MJL, PYO | SRA | Product |

Modules this solution relates to but which is not directly a part of the solution itself:

- 001_log_ms: Used for logging purposes. Must be installed individually for each customer.
- 001_common_ms: Used for common dimensions. Must be installed individually for each customer.
- 001_FOLKEREG_DSA: Connected via Linked Server.
- 001_GEOADRESSE_EDW: Connected via Linked Server.


## Solution Architecture

JOBLOG follows a custom DSA_SSIS_TXT_GENERIC and traditional DataArea architecture jobflow with extract (based on powershell and DSA_SSIS_TXT_GENERIC), transform, load.

Powershell was adjusted to perform some additional operations in order to reforamt received data and adjust it to the standard Framework worfklow. The load job runs JOBLOG_DSA powershell script, it needs to be run as server_sqlagent, steps of the scripts are:
- establishing connection to sftp
- checking if there are new files on sftp (compares dates from file names and date from files previously loaded to the DSA)
- checking if all files are ready on sftp
- cleaning InZip directory and downloading files
- cleaning UnZip directory and extracting zip
- cleaning IN folder, processing unzipped files (delimiter is changed, header removed, text quantifiers added) and moving the to IN directory
- Running SSIS
- checking if DSAdatefrom was archived in logs
- archiving zip files in arch directory

## Schedule
It runs 5th,10th days in month (Monthly load).


## Universe Description

Currently there is only one Universe with
- facts:
    - JoblogCore
    - IF_Citizen_GeoAdresse (Intermidiate fact connecing only dimensions Citizen and GeoAdresse)
- dimensions:
    - CoreEntry
    - JobSearchEntry
    - JobSearchStatus
    - OtherEntry
    - Citizen
    - GeoCoordinatequalityType
    - GeoAdresse

**Dimension Citizen** is based on CPR number from the 09_tblCprPersonId and 09_tblCprPersonId_TILFLYTNING source files, rest of data is fetched from tables [archive].[FOLKEREG_EDW_BORGER_BOSÆTTELSE], [archive].[FOLKEREG_EDW_BORGER_OPLYSNINGER] and [archive].[FOLKEREG_EDW_VEJREGISTER], which come from module [001_FOLKEREG_DSA].[GLOBAL_FOLKEREG_01_DSA] accessed via LinkedServer.

**Dimension GeoAdresse** is a usual implementation of GeoAdresse, exisiting in most solutions, data are fetched from [dimension].[GeoAdresse] from module [001_GEOADRESSE_EDW].[GLOBAL_GEOADRESSE_02_EDW] accessed via LinkedServer.

**GeoCoordinatequalityType** is populated with data fetched from 001_dsa_codelist. This data is also accusable here: https://starwiki.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/FYS/pages/91816135/GeoCoordinateQualityTypeIdentifier

All other dimensions are populated with data from source files with corresponding names. Some values, if necessary, are translated using 001_dsa_codelist. More details can be found here: [Design Sepcifications](https://kmddk.sharepoint.com/sites/Dima-365/Delte%20dokumenter/Forms/AllItems.aspx?FolderCTID=0x0120007E96A0A0A2F41747A73853F4D2D9C4C4&OR=Teams%2DHL&CT=1658390592727&clickparams=eyJBcHBOYW1lIjoiVGVhbXMtRGVza3RvcCIsIkFwcFZlcnNpb24iOiIyNy8yMjA2MDYxNDgwNSIsIkhhc0ZlZGVyYXRlZFVzZXIiOmZhbHNlfQ%3D%3D&isAscending=false&id=%2Fsites%2FDima%2D365%2FDelte%20dokumenter%2FGeneral%2F03%20Udviklingsprojekter%2FUP%20%2D%205640%20SUP%20%28STARsUdstillingplatform%29%2F03%2E%20Development%2FDesign%20specifications&sortField=Modified&viewid=2d2179a1%2D6ce0%2D4272%2D8741%2D5932ad72e0ed)

Dimensions CoreEntry, JobSearchEntry, JobSearchStatus, OtherEntry and Citizen and also Fact JoblogCore require data from both base and Tilflytning tables. Merging the data happens in the Work tables, for each dimension (for fact in table WorkCoreEntry). Data in base and Tilflytning is supposed to not have any common part, but such case is handled so any identical rows shouldn't be stored twice.

Work tables are source in further mapping and stage procedures.

After every full load data is changed, some records are removed from the source, some are added. Added records are processed with standard framework flow. We established that we don't want to show records which were removed from the source. Because of that there are delete clauses in dimension procedures which compare dimension with the work table (work tables are truncated and populated with every load) and delete row missing in work table from the dimension table.

**Dimension JobSearchStatus** is aggregated in the stage procedure. Source table for this dimension contains multiple statuses for one JobSearchEntry, in the dimension we store only the newest status, not older than from 2 years in the past.

D:\KMD\Config\PowerShell

(Make sure drive is correct)

![image.png](/.attachments/image-e3d6fd56-06f8-483a-aac5-a367e3e1c6a4.png)

##servers.txt

This text file needs to contain all servers that information needs to be extracted from
If local servername is not known use following powershell command to find the name:

```
(Get-WMIObject win32_operatingsystem).csname 
```
Just put the names into the text file separated by a new line:
![image.png](/.attachments/image-fe197f17-56d6-4653-b1d7-87c4154a99c2.png)

##script.cfg

This is a configuration file that needs to be changed for each customer
![image.png](/.attachments/image-b380d3f8-9a70-4010-98aa-3a2efc98d802.png)


- customer
>number of the customer
- VFSFolder
>Folder that Targit visualisations are found.
- SettingsFolder
>Targit settings folder (see below if not on same server)
- PublishedFolders
>PublishedFolders location
- SolutionsFolder
>SolutionFolder location
- targetserver
>server to send information to (KMDDBS2134)
- Datafolder
> Folder containing the physical InMemory Databases
- NotReportingSolutions
> Solutions not to be reported on be StatusReport.ps1 - seperated with commas, and * allows for any trailing text.


##Getting settings when Targit is installed on a different server

If Targit is not installed on the InMemory server then the settings folder needs to be shared with the Targit service account. 
(Found on passwords.kmd.dk)

![image.png](/.attachments/image-6340791f-3981-472b-bf1d-4b954c8aa8da.png)


Then the folder can be accessed from the InMemory Server:

![image.png](/.attachments/image-7c1a3da3-7b67-420c-b421-ae9f0d786b42.png)

The network address then needs to be put into the config file


##GetDataModelVersions.ps1

This script gets information about all InMemory connections on the AntServer and their ETL packages that are run by Targit InMemory Scheduler

##Diskvolume.ps1
This is the script that pulls information from all servers listed in the servers text file.

---

#Automating the script
On the InMemory server open Task Scheduler
If a KMD folder doesn’t exist then create one:

![image.png](/.attachments/image-63fd8486-dc13-44c3-a134-a698320d5597.png)

Right click and create new task in KMD folder:
![image.png](/.attachments/image-370d5b68-97a6-415a-9c7b-a648d8396898.png)

Change name to DiskVolume and change the user account to the service account 
(found on passwords.kmd.dk)

Then set it to “Run whether user is logged on or not”

![image.png](/.attachments/image-83a7c989-315f-4234-bb5d-bbb54c7f7d94.png)

On the Triggers tab, create a new trigger and set it to run at 05:00:00 every day:

![image.png](/.attachments/image-3a296428-09ec-487e-9bf0-6d7b562254b4.png)

On the Actions tab you need to tell it to execute the file using PowerShell:
Insert powershell exe in Program/script:
```
powershell.exe
```
And insert the filepath in “Add arguments (optional):”
```
-file "D:\KMD\Config\PowerShell\DiskVolume.ps1"
```
**Make sure the drive is right.**

Click OK and OK to create the task.
Insert the password for the service account:

![image.png](/.attachments/image-2f879f9f-5b75-4d5a-a828-76f5d6623f5b.png)

If you get an error stating that you need to have “Log on as batch job” permission to create task then you need to run 
```
lusrmgr.msc
```
![image.png](/.attachments/image-14e7f8cd-f938-489c-bdee-1065de929f2d.png)

And add the service account to Groups Administrators:

![image.png](/.attachments/image-1ccc7f5c-3821-4e5f-b6c7-2d13876f8fec.png)

Then you can run the job.

![image.png](/.attachments/image-32f3c637-aac4-4673-b2f0-a355a23281ba.png)

If you get this error 2147943712

![image.png](/.attachments/image-3c988983-9d5c-42a8-a527-ba5f5d45aa93.png)

Go into local security policy and disable "Network Access: Do not allow storage of passwords and credentials for network authentication"
Location is shown in the image above.

Do the same for the Datamodel version script and StatusReport script.

___
#Script details

##DiskVolume
The script runs through the servers in the text file and collects info on OS and disk sizes:

![image.png](/.attachments/image-ff19a300-c2d0-4c2b-b64c-61df57989ace.png)

It then executes the stored procedure [kmdbi].[Targit_InsertSystemInformation] on the KMDDBS2134 server with all the information gathered:
![image.png](/.attachments/image-a4fe9234-a9ae-4667-b76c-2f2991d365ad.png)

This inserts new data into the [kmdbi].[SystemInformation] table if it doesn’t exist. And updates data if it already exists.


The next part gets the Targit version from the settings file and executes a stored procedure that updates the Targit version on the customer with the version from the xml file.

![image.png](/.attachments/image-dddb5df7-6cba-4fe0-9f2b-8781d6da8ddd.png)

##GetDataModelVersions

The script starts by building an array with information from all the ETL packages in the "publishedfolders" 

![image.png](/.attachments/image-6eca5189-bee0-44d6-ac9d-3c6ffcf91c2a.png)

It then loops through all connections from the AntServer and collects some info from each connection:

![image.png](/.attachments/image-34ad5d6e-7b62-49f7-b3e1-345a52f99e08.png)

Then it uses the id from the connection to find the datamodel and inmemory database and collect info from thes including the datamodel version

![image.png](/.attachments/image-beb57b0c-54a1-42b1-97e2-1f4d9fc79f8c.png)

then it loops through all etl packages to find any that deploys to the same InMemory Database that the datamodel uses.

If then inserts it to an SQL database.
If no etl package is found then it inserts as well but without ETL info

![image.png](/.attachments/image-ab4b7601-1c21-42bf-b550-4d557b361caa.png)

##Status report

The script starts by running trhough all .impd files found in the PublishedFolders folder
![image.png](/.attachments/image-50787fac-d4c6-405f-91e6-43653e7055eb.png)

it then filters out solutions based on the NotReportingSolutions variable:
![image.png](/.attachments/image-9a728daa-3497-4b55-9dc5-fd4076e2485e.png)

then it gets the starttime, status, runtime and other things from the .impd file and .log file:

![image.png](/.attachments/image-3e316eac-5533-42c9-a324-7c3af074d8e2.png)

Finally it runs through all logged runs and inserts data into the SQL server database on KMDDBS2134.
![image.png](/.attachments/image-7f728731-6066-4405-922f-55e486d677f3.png)

Herunder findes den relevante dokumentation til vores processer i PDT3.


![image.png](/.attachments/image-b8365a84-5917-4029-92e4-7889866b6f70.png) ![image.png](/.attachments/image-5f303ac9-a88d-4ad6-a7d2-2ca9518c0df6.png) Ændringsarket kan findes her : [HER](https://kmddk.sharepoint.com/:x:/s/TargitForvaltning-365/EUvcbvulSTRPgsX5WtWtLxABd7hw5DEw6v-0FlSTSa6PkA?e=ySnFL6)
![image.png](/.attachments/image-c7cc2f53-3d88-48d2-9b99-0ff6e5b4824c.png)

path: /Archive/Portal - Access Application/Adding Accesses in Portal - Not Used Anymore
content:
This solution is developed to make easier adding accesses in Portal.


**How to use:**

1. Download code from SVN: https://internsvn.dima.kmd.dk/im/TRUNK/Produkter/tool_portalpsscripts.
2. Set accesses in file PP_params_template.json and rename it to PP_params.json. More details on how to configure it, is described in section below.
3. Run PowerShell script PP_requestAccess.ps1, using "Run with PowerShell".
4. You will see on a console which accesses were added or skipped because it exists. On the end You will get information about all active accesses You have.
![image.png](/.attachments/image-bc510498-b23d-46b0-a4e3-1c3239982e52.png)
5. You can edit list of access and run it again. Don't worry to keep active accesses on list, those will be skipped, and You will see information about that on console(no error).

**Configuration description of file PP_params:**

Example:
![image.png](/.attachments/image-bc4488b3-f2bd-45be-8d41-1b992f17dc7d.png)

**User** - it is email address of Your user in Portal

![image.png](/.attachments/image-37ce53f9-78be-4f20-b1db-2aa52de16765.png)

**RequestsDatabase** - in that section You can add accesses for specific databases. Here You can only add accesses on Development servers. 

**RequestsArea** - in that section You can add accesses for specific area. 

**Environment** - define on which environment access will be added, use PROD or DEV

**Server** - server name on which You want to add access, it is only used for database requests. In case on backslash in server name You need to double it, to avoid json parsing error. Example: ![image.png](/.attachments/image-9fa19ebc-6762-4e47-9248-3af87cf15a02.png)

**database** - database name, it is only used for database requests.

**Area** - area name, it is only used for area requests.

**customer** - customer number, it is only used for arear equests.

**ifIqAccess** - Iq acces is 1, sql server access is 0.

**durationInHours** - how long access is valid, correct values: 1, 3, 6, 8, 12, 24, 48, 168(1 week)

**ifRoleWriter** - if You want to add access with writer role, use 1 or 0.

**ifRoleDDLadmin**- if You want to add access with DDL admin role, use 1 or 0.

**reason** - reason description

**SmartExpire** - if it is smart expire, use 1 or 0.

path: /Technology & Software/2. Targit/2.11 Tools/2.11.2 Modify Version Number
content:
#Script summary
ModifyVersionNumber.ps1 is a script that can be used to modify version numbers for all connected packages.
- Both ETL and Datamodel.

Version numbers are collected and sent back to KMD by script described here: [Targit System Information](https://dev.azure.com/kmd-dima/KMD.DIMA.LG/_wiki/wikis/KMD.DIMA.LG.wiki/3721/Targit-System-Information)

Information can be found in Targit Operation: http://172.31.112.31:8080/

Operations > JOB INMEMORY > SOLUTION INFO

![image.png](/.attachments/image-e55b4afe-8d83-42c8-8c27-9652493ba441.png)

#Requirements
You need to following files deployed to D:\KMD\Config\PowerShell (or E:\ for some customers)
**script.cfg**
**ModifyVersionNumber.ps1**

Files can be found on SVN at ...\targit\tools\StatusReporting

If **script.cfg** is not already on the customer server it means that [Targit System Information](https://dev.azure.com/kmd-dima/KMD.DIMA.LG/_wiki/wikis/KMD.DIMA.LG.wiki/3721/Targit-System-Information)
has not been set up for the customer. It would be helpful if you followed the guide linked to get that working as well.

script.cfg needs to be edited to have the correct paths (already done if [Targit System Information](https://dev.azure.com/kmd-dima/KMD.DIMA.LG/_wiki/wikis/KMD.DIMA.LG.wiki/3721/Targit-System-Information) is set up)

![image.png](/.attachments/image-122ef6ba-06ad-4f4a-b3dc-93145b4c785b.png)


- customer
>number of the customer
- VFSFolder
>Folder that Targit visualisations are found.
- SettingsFolder
>Targit settings folder (see below if not on same server)
- PublishedFolders
>PublishedFolders location
- SolutionsFolder
>SolutionFolder location
- targetserver
>server to send information to (KMDDBS2134)


#Script guide
You need to run the ModifyVersionNumber script.
You can either run the script using Powershell or Powershell (ISE)

![image.png](/.attachments/image-e3d48ff8-2256-4b53-8a3a-7247cd751b86.png)
Edit to run with (ISE) which doesn't close down on error or when finished, which improves usability.

1. **Press F5 in Powershell ISE to start the script.**

The script finds all ETL Projects in the solutions folder of the server that have a version number:

![image.png](/.attachments/image-f1307b6c-80f3-4f03-b6b5-acfba0e5e4e8.png)
2. **Enter ID of solution you want to modify the version of**

If you only know the connection/datamodel then check the InMemory database using Targit Management Studio.

![image.png](/.attachments/image-61a6d1e2-6897-4fe5-ae04-28678ec8207f.png)
![image.png](/.attachments/image-f1a119e1-eef2-4ae1-8e9e-bc208f23bddc.png)

If the solution you want to modify is not listed it is because it doesn't have any version number attached.

![image.png](/.attachments/image-501e550d-e9aa-466c-85bf-3332780ee42e.png)


You can either copy it from the StandardETL.improj found on SVN at ...\targit\standard\etl_template

Or add a script to the ETL package with name "Version" the following code:
```sql
//Version (KMDMajor, KMDMinor, Customer, Build) | Releasedate  | Author
DECLARE @PackageVersion AS STRING
DECLARE @PackageReleasedate AS STRING
DECLARE @PackageAuthor AS STRING

SET @PackageVersion = '2.0.000.00001'
SET @PackageReleasedate = '2023-03-08'
SET @PackageAuthor = 'RTE'
```
And edit the values to fit the project.

**Remember to deploy the ETL Package**

You can then stop the script by pressing enter with no number and run it again.

3. **Modify version number**

The script looks up all deployed ETL packages and datamodels connected to the ETL package:

![image.png](/.attachments/image-00b2c24e-d7a3-404e-9bff-7a049b01d9d3.png)
If none of the packages/models have any version number that fits the current version number policy the only option you have is to add it manually by entering 0.

Otherwise it will look like this:
![image.png](/.attachments/image-dc589d53-3f13-41ae-975d-51a2c0698462.png)
Where you can choose any of the eligible version numbers and work with it.

##Set manually
If you select "Set manually" then you get the following:
![image.png](/.attachments/image-4160e8d2-e5d6-4acf-8b14-778dab2cd663.png)

You will have to enter the major number, the minor number and the build number.

If the version you enter does not match policy then you will be prompted to try again:
![image.png](/.attachments/image-70cfc304-343b-48df-ab77-fda720602261.png)

It will then add the version to all packages found. To check that it ran  correctly you can run the package again and select the same ETL package to see all version numbers:
![image.png](/.attachments/image-378d511b-3e68-48f5-a8dd-61a80d660ec6.png)

##Work with existing version number
If you select an existing version number you will first be prompted whether to increment the build number or not.
(You can leave it empty if you don't want to increment it)

Then you will be asked if you want to modify the version number:
![image.png](/.attachments/image-96193656-f983-43b8-b8dd-2ba028f6bfda.png)

If  you chose to modify the version number it will be just like for manually creating the version number except that you can press enter to not change major/minor/customer/build.
![image.png](/.attachments/image-cf401c30-3b4c-44f5-af43-143e23f9a9be.png)

Then the version is added to all packages and you can check by running again if you want.

#Script description

path: /Technology & Software/2. Targit/2.8 Targit Operations/2.8.1 Conditional Start
content: #Description Conditional Start are ETL-packages run by Targit InMemory Scheduler Management These packages check if data for a specific solution is ready. If the data is ready then it starts that solution's own ETL-package ***unless*** it has already been run that day. Otherwise it does nothing. This is meant to replace schedules on individual packages. It ensures that data is only collected when ready and can also rerun packages if they failed for some reason. #Prerequisites 1. ETL package that needs to be started by conditional start 2. Update Frequency of that ETL package Daily/Weekly/Monthly 3. Conditional Start ETL package This is found on SVN at: .../Interne/targit/standard/conditional run/ConditionalStart.improj 4. Area name of solution Check the [Project_EDW] column of the CDim_MartInfo table example for OPUS Vagtplan: ![image.png](/.attachments/image-b156f6c7-469e-4edc-bcdb-05bbebf3c254.png) name is OPUSVAGTPLAN 5. Name of InMemory Database Can be found in Either main package ETL or in **Targit InMemory Scheduler Management** ![image.png](/.attachments/image-ee460096-cac3-4bbd-b585-f3bfa1ec730c.png) #Installation 1. **Add package to server** Move the ConditionalStart package to D:\KMD\Install\Solutions\KMD\ConditionalStart or equivalent on the customer InMemory Server. 2. **Edit package** ###Change the name of the package so that the name has the following syntax: ``` ConditionalStart_SolutionName ``` for example: ![image.png](/.attachments/image-56d6974d-ba37-4a76-8510-2e21bfd6b5d9.png) ###Change file name and InMemory Database Name ![image.png](/.attachments/image-913bc4cc-1396-4735-86da-34e6a523521e.png) to ![image.png](/.attachments/image-b60df2a6-1857-4d90-a0c3-a252f38cdfd9.png) ###Change "Set configurations" ![image.png](/.attachments/image-ebfe39fe-5f9b-49bc-942e-b1c673efb5d9.png) ``` sql @Solution_DataReady @Environment ``` needs to match KMDBI connection in TargitSources file (D:\KMD\Config\Targit\TargitSources.csv) ``` sql @ListOfArea ``` needs to match the last part of Project_EDW found in CDim_MartInfo - use the AreaID of the main Fact table ``` sql @SolutionStatus ``` needs to match the InMemory Database Name of the solution that the Conditional start is meant to start. Example: ![image.png](/.attachments/image-0bb70871-1ff3-478b-a82c-42f05ce9eca3.png) >Change package that is started by Conditional Start Double click "Run IMPD" and chose the package to start: ![image.png](/.attachments/image-598755e0-bf02-4847-8ef1-6e62f7e20d19.png) ###Set up schedule Click *Configure* on *Schedules* in the *Properties* panel ![image.png](/.attachments/image-77ca9dde-76f9-4135-bb45-0c4fdbb78434.png) You need to know when the data is updated and then click Add a schedule depending on when the package needs to be updated. Try to run it multiple times during the night so that the solution gets updated when ready. Also try not to run at the same time as other conditional run packages (e.g. run at 35 mins past the hour to not get an overlap) ![image.png](/.attachments/image-c1ccc08a-4a03-457f-8cb6-1b496140132a.png) ###Deploy package Configure first and make sure you deploy to the *KMD* folder ![image.png](/.attachments/image-60fa4355-5ce8-420f-be74-7e33a481d109.png) Then click deploy. ###Test run Try to run the package. Most likely you will find that the data is already updated or that data is not ready. ![image.png](/.attachments/image-eea06241-492c-4a5e-9ea1-b2ad78bef27a.png) In that case you might need to return a few days later to check that it is running correctly. 3. **Remove schedule from main ETL solution** Find the solution started by the conditional start here: D:\KMD\Install\Solutions open it - remove any schedule - Save - then deploy the package. Check in **Targit InMemory Scheduler Management** if any schedule remain - if so remove the schedule. ![image.png](/.attachments/image-3458b59f-022f-4b82-89c9-73e061b67798.png)

path: /Technology & Software/2. Targit/2.5 Installation/2.5.2 Migrating to a Two-Server Setup
content:
[[_TOC_]]


# **Preparation**
Before the migration process starts, you can already install the TARGIT components on the different servers. The following guide can be used to see how we set up new servers: https://dev.azure.com/kmd-dima/KMD.DIMA.LG/_wiki/wikis/KMD.DIMA.LG.wiki/3419/Setting-up-a-new-server-for-a-new-customer-on-a-2-server-setup. Please note, that the TARGIT installation must have the same build number as the TARGIT version on the old - this is done to ensure compatibility between the two servers.


# **Migration process** 
The migration process typically contains a 'cut-over'-date. This date is agreed upon with the customer and KMD. The meaning behind the cut-over date is, that any work that has been done after this date, will not be migrated to the new setup. The idea is that we only have to copy the folders and structure once from the old server, to the new server. The following headers showcases the different steps which needs to be done in order to migrate from an old server to a new. _Please note that every customer is different, so this guide can only be used as an indicator to which needs to be done, but might not contain customer specific details_

# **TARGIT Server**

The following section requires a clean installation of the relevant TARGIT components in according to https://dev.azure.com/kmd-dima/KMD.DIMA.LG/_wiki/wikis/KMD.DIMA.LG.wiki/3419/Setting-up-a-new-server-for-a-new-customer-on-a-2-server-setup.

- Remember to run the 'TARGIT Server'-service with the same service account.

- Install customer related programs, for example R, Power BI - typically agreed upon with the customer in the 
introductory talks.

- Set up networkshares as on the old server
Take a backup to D:\KMD\Backup (or equivalent)
You can use the following robocopy .bat text as a template for taking the backup: 

```bat
@echo off

set /p "buildNbr=Input build number "

for /f "tokens=2 delims==" %%I in ('wmic os get localdatetime /format:list') do set datetime=%%I
set dtstr=%datetime:~0,8%

robocopy "C:\ProgramData\Targit" "D:\KMD\Backup\%dtstr%\Build %buildNbr%\ProgramData" /e
robocopy "C:\inetpub\wwwroot" "D:\KMD\Backup\%dtstr%\Build %buildNbr%\wwwroot" /e
robocopy "C:\Program Files\TARGIT\TARGIT Data Service" "D:\KMD\Backup\%dtstr%\Build %buildNbr%\Targit Data Service" /e

pause
``` 


- Copy the following settings folders from the old setup to the new setup (unless anything else is agreed upon with the customer). This is easiest done with robocopy using networkshares* - **Please note that the 'TARGIT Server'-service must be stopped on the new server while copying**:
  - VFS - typically in the path "C:\ProgramData\Targit\AntServer\VFS"
  - Settings - typically in the path "C:\ProgramData\Targit\AntServer\Settings"

  - **Robocopying using networkshares**
The easiest way to copy from the old server to the new server is using robocopy on networkshares. This is both faster and a more secure way of copying. Example below where the networkshare is created on the old server: KMDAPP2236 on the share: "C:\ProgramData\Targit\AntServer". See below:
`robocopy "\\kmdapp2236\ANTServer\VFS" "C:\ProgramData\TARGIT\ANTServer\VFS" /e` 

  - After copying all relevant files, the 'TARGIT Server'-service can be started again. Please confirm that the relevant copied TARGIT components are working as intended, such as: analysis in TARGIT, various settings in TARGIT, TARGIT Management for license, connections, roles etc.
  

- **Anywhere** The customers IT-department has to change the DNS so it points to the new server/Ip adress. Example from Holbæk:
Anywhere link: "kmd-lis.holb.dk/touchserver" then they have to change the DNS so that kmd-lis.holb.dk/touchserver points to the new server.
Remember to be aware of the customer specific modifications in the IIS. 
Also be aware of HTTPS-binding. This needs a SSL-certificate, which needs to be put on by the customers IT-department. Afterward we have to put the SSL certificate on the TARGIT management client, and after this put the binding on in IIS. 
  - ANYWHERE CONFIGURATION: Remember to install .net and install the following components in the 'Server Manager'
![image.png](/.attachments/image-428fb771-cb57-409f-87a0-ef7095d3842c.png).



- **Data Discovery:** Use the following guide: https://dev.azure.com/kmd-dima/KMD.DIMA.LG/_wiki/wikis/KMD.DIMA.LG.wiki/3417/Move-Data-Discovery-setup-from-one-server-to-another-server

- **TARGIT logning:** Use the following guides: 

*Please be aware of the size of the TARGITlog before doing a backup/restore. SQL Express can only handle 10GB databases, and we need to make sure, that the current database is not larger than this*


  - Setting up SQL Management Studio database and backup/restore from old SQL server to the new **WIP**: https://dev.azure.com/kmd-dima/KMD.DIMA.LG/_wiki/wikis/KMD.DIMA.LG.wiki/4138/SQL-Express-installation-WIP- 
  - Setting up TARGIT auxiliary database:  https://dev.azure.com/kmd-dima/KMD.DIMA.LG/_wiki/wikis/KMD.DIMA.LG.wiki/3418/Setting-up-the-logging-functionality - this is usually not necessary because when you copy the Settings-folder, there will already be an auxiliary database.

  - If the customer has the 'TARGITLog'-cube the ETL project will run on the InMemory server - for relevant information regarding connection see: https://dev.azure.com/kmd-dima/KMD.DIMA.LG/_wiki/wikis/KMD.DIMA.LG.wiki/4138/SQL-Express-installation-WIP- 

- Please be aware of 3rd party connections such as "FLIS DAP", "Schultz Expose" etc. If these connections do not work properly coordinate with the customer and the corresponding PL. 

- Certificates on the new server. The customers IT-department is handling the certificates on the server. Coordinate and pinpoint which relevant certificates you need. This could be certificates like 'SSL'- and "FLIS DAP"-certificates etc.

# **InMemory Server**
The following section requires a clean installation of the relevant TARGIT components in according to https://dev.azure.com/kmd-dima/KMD.DIMA.LG/_wiki/wikis/KMD.DIMA.LG.wiki/3419/Setting-up-a-new-server-for-a-new-customer-on-a-2-server-setup.

- Copy all relevant files and projects from the KMD-drive, usually "D:\KMD\..."
  - This primarily includes ETL-projects ("D:\KMD\Install\Solutions-folder") and Config-folder (TargitSources.csv and Powershell scripts):
![image.png](/.attachments/image-20c3085b-bf75-4f05-9515-a2b1066d69f2.png)
  - We usually do not copy anything related to the "Targit"-folder, however it is generally a good idea to robocopy a new backup into the backup folder.

- Remember to change your "licenseserver" in the TARGITDB.ini-file to point to the TARGIT server (which has the license). The TARGITDB.ini-file can typically be found in following path: 'C:\Program Files\TARGIT\TARGIT InMemoryDB'
![image.png](/.attachments/image-9313c717-8de5-469d-8f91-1a530d3098d9.png)


- Restart both servers after editing the "Licenseserver" in the targitdb.ini file.

- Disable connections which do not work - these hinder and delays TARGIT.

# General:

- The service account needs to be administrator on all servers, this is done by searching out 'Edit local users and groups' --> Go to Groups --> Administrators --> Add the service user and apply:
![image.png](/.attachments/image-7f36c85e-e55c-4e61-b073-d3521631661f.png)

- When migrating to new servers we usually try to change the connections to Dataout - coordinate this with PEY/TNH/JMB and the corresponding PL.

- Coordinate with the customer/corresponding PL if there are any uncertainties about the new server or which files to copy etc.


# Migrations to a multi-server setup (3 or more)
This often includes a separate Data Discovery server. The abovementioned can be used as well, however for information regarding the data discovery server the following guide can be used: https://dev.azure.com/kmd-dima/KMD.DIMA.LG/_wiki/wikis/KMD.DIMA.LG.wiki/3513/Installing-Data-Discovery-on-a-separate-server

Check "Grant Perform Volume Maintenance Task privilege to SQL Server Database Engine Service" and press "Collation" in the top

Collation is set as seen above to "Danish_Norwegian_CI_AS"


![image.png](/.attachments/image-dd7e9c9e-455a-4cf5-ba1c-047dc85441a9.png)

Data directories is set as seen above. The folders has to be manually created and is not a part of the SQL express installation.

![image.png](/.attachments/image-216f954b-8754-4c2d-ac1d-a086a6bc63a1.png)

# Creating the database on the SQL express
When adding a database to the newly created SQL express version, following configurations needs to be made:
Set intial size to 5128 MB and autogrowth to 256 MB. The reason for this is, that it is best that the initial size and autogrowth can hit the max size of 10248 MB.
![image.png](/.attachments/image-66f691b2-29f6-4a8a-892e-7461272762d2.png)
remember to change the collation under options as well^.


# TARGIT log cube (ETL)

If you need to install the TARGITLog ETL on the InMemory server, you'll have to do the following configurations. 

## Multi-server setup
If you are installing SQL Express in a multi server setup - for example if you install the SQL server/Database on the TARGIT server and you need to run the TARGIT LOG ETL on the InMemory server, then you have to do Enable "TCP/IP" under "SQL Server Network Configuration" -> "Protocols for MSSQLSERVER" in "Sql Server Configuration Manager" as seen below:

## KMD_Targitlog_reader
For security measures we need to create a new KMD_TARGITLOG_READER on the SQL server, which is to be used in TargitSources.csv.

Under Security --> Logins, create a new login:
![image.png](/.attachments/image-d8233cb7-e2a0-4729-88fb-945b127652ec.png)
Create a new user to be used as read-user with same settings as below:
REMEMBER TO ADD THE PASSWORD TO PASSWORDS.KMD.DK.
![image.png](/.attachments/image-870552ea-f443-4795-be82-463424202f53.png)

Right click and enter properties on the "kmd_targitlog_reader" under Logins:

![image.png](/.attachments/image-c83ca09d-1986-40d1-9cd0-1bbdf1f402e8.png)

/Technology & Software/2. Targit/2.8 Targit Operations/2.8.2 Upgrading TARGIT Suite on Existing Customers
/Technology & Software/2. Targit/2.9 Support/2.9.3 Who is Responsible
/Technology & Software/2. Targit/2.6 Development/2.6.3 Approach to Developing Norm Cubes (how PDT3 did it)
content:
It is important to highlight that the described approach is the way the PDT3 team has chosen to do it, other approaches can of course also be useful in relation to the development of norm cubes.

In addition, it may depend on which approach they choose; They may already have a solution that they consider their standard solution, and thus they just have to choose this as a standard cube going forward and possibly make the improvements that they may have planned for the solution anyway. If they have customers where the data models vary, then you can try our approach, where we have done the following:

1.	Retrieve all TARGIT ETL projects and data models from all customers. Here we can recommend checking the customer-specific ETL projects and data models into SVN in folders each with their own municipality number, so you still have all current versions saved in case there should be a need to find them later.
2.	We have used Notepad++ to compare the SQL code in ETL projects (the code is retrieved via TARGIT InMemory ETL Studio) and data models (these can be compared directly as they are pure XML code), but other tools can undoubtedly also be used. 
3.	We have chosen to start with the ETL project and data model that is most representative of the norm cube solution that we would like to use in the future, and then compare them with all variants of ETL projects and data models that may be available at the individual customers.
4.	When we have compared the code between two projects and data models, we have just chosen, from start to end, what should be included and what should not be included in a future norm cube.
5.	There have been a few cases where there have been variations of the fact tables in the ETL projects, and since we have not been able to completely unify this, we have chosen to control it via variables so that different ETL can be executed based on municipality number. This has allowed us to maintain the same ETL project across customers.
6.	During the process, we also chose to try to unify the date dimension across the solutions where relevant. This means that the most common dimensions are found in all the solutions, but there may be additions in the individual solutions due to subject-specific content.
We have a version of a common date dimension built into our solutions, but do not have any documentation on it, so reach out to PDT3 for possible sparring about this.

As said, this is our approach to the development of norm cubes, there may be specific things that are not necessarily handled by this review, so we need to take that up and assess how we should handle when it arises.

path: /Technology & Software/2. Targit/2.7 Production/2.7.6 Deployment/Where to Deploy Solutions
/Technology & Software/2. Targit/2.6 Development/2.6.4 Approach to Maintaining Norm Cubes
content:
This document describes the approach to maintaining norm cubes

When a norm cube is being prepared for release, the last changes are committed to SVN/GIT with a comment saying "#RELEASE# version: x.xxx.xxxxx" (version number should be equivalent to updated version numbers in ETL project and data model). This way, you can easily retrieve files for latest norm cube (by retrieving the release revision), while working on, and committing, changes for the next norm cube release. 

Changes to norm cubes should be added continuously, when they are fresh in the developers memory, instead of piling up change requests/records and implementing them right before next norm cube release. In case we do have a big pile of changes that should be added to the norm cube branch within a short amount of time, as few developers as possible should be working on the collect task, to prevent concurrency problems working on the same files.

Only official releases are released to customers, who have a norm cube subscription, daily builds are not released to customers. If a critical bug is found, the bug can be fixed on the customers setup, if, and only if, the same fix is added to the norm cube branch at the same time. This is done to ensure that all norm cube subscribers will eventually receive the bug fix when updating their ETL and/or data model.

If customer resides on their own version of a cube on a specific solution, changes and additions to the cubes content are added by request, and when the task is done (remember to update version numbers in ETL project and the data model), changes are committed to SVN/GIT immediately afterwards, with a fulfilling description in the comment section, and a record describing the change is committed to the general change log. If changes are found relevant for the upcoming norm cube release, they can be advantageously added to the norm cube branch at the same time.

path: /Teams/1. Administrative Domain Team/1.5 Customer Specific Solutions/1.5.1 Holbæks Måltalsark
content:
[[_TOC_]] Holbæk benytter sig af måltalsark til deres Opus Fravær (Opus Løn og Personale). Måltalsarket bliver benyttet til at koble Holbæks Opus Fravær løsning op til KRL måltal. Måltalsarkene leveres én gang årligt af Holbæk Kommune - lige efter årsskiftet og typisk planlægges det ind i januar sprintet hos KMD. Dette er grundet, at Holbæk har brug for nye måltal for det nye år (fx et nyt måltalsark med data for 2024). Følgende side forklarer med eksempler hvordan vi løser denne opgave som KMD'er. 316_Maaltals-modulet benytter sig af to moduler: - 316_MAALTAL_01_DSA - 316_MAALTAL_02_EDW Ved tilpasning af Måltalsløsningen ved nyt måltalsark skal vi kun lave tilpasninger til DSA-modulet. EDW'et og frem skal vi ikke røre ved # DSA modulet DSA'et er bygget op omkring 9 tabeller: ![image.png](/.attachments/image-533acdf3-09cd-4820-b3b7-b259e319cd52.png). Disse tabeller indeholder årsspecifikke kolonner: ![image.png](/.attachments/image-556b9aa1-c428-436b-8136-e00d9febc530.png) Ved indlæsning af nyt måltalsark ved årsskifte - som indeholder et nyt år - så skal vi ind i modulet og tilpasse tabellerne: ![image.png](/.attachments/image-98dc51a4-410e-4092-abab-03003ed1cdb7.png) Herinde tilføjes der ekstra linjer alt efter hvilket år der skal læses ind. Det er vigtigt at det matcher de andre kolonneoverskrifter, samt det matcher dét, som står i excel-arket leveret af Holbæk. Dette er fordi, at dataen indlæses af en DPS-config, og den indlæser kun dét data, som matcher på navn - og indlæsningen tager også højde for store/små bogstaver. ![image.png](/.attachments/image-3449a3ef-3905-41f1-a3df-7bac4202bb8d.png) Hvis Holbæk anmoder om at få fjernet tidligere årstal, kan rækkerne også blot slettes heri. Det er så dog vigtigt, at de også bliver slettet både i DPS-Configgen samt i Holbæks måltalsark. # DPS-Config **OBS** *denne del er forældet - vi indlæser nu via powershell scripts* Extract jobbet benytter sig af en DPSConfig til at importere Excel-arkene (Måltalsarkene). Denne DPS Config ligger også i modulet som i stien heruder: ![image.png](/.attachments/image-082c2538-99c9-4c46-8a32-fad8a4101f6e.png) DPS-Configgen styrer hvilken data der skal indlæses samt hvilken server og database den skal loade dataen ind i. DPS-Configgen er indsat her som kode for 2024: ```
``` Herunder vil jeg lige gennemgå de steder, hvor ændringerne til DPS-configgen skal laves: Linjerne markeret med gult bestemmer hvilke excel faner der skal indlæses. Dette skal vi ikke ændre på, da den er sat dynamisk op, så vi skal ikke tilføje til et nyt år. Det vigtige her er, at igen få tilføjet det nye år (markeret med rød boks): ### Loenklasse *OBS på at der både skal tilføjes for "2024 Sygefraværspct" OG "2024 Dagsværk"* ![image.png](/.attachments/image-d8560bd7-766f-4c94-8e0c-9a7641d164e5.png) ### Trend ![image.png](/.attachments/image-a93ae220-33ea-4110-a39e-e33d93dacad7.png) ### Justering ![image.png](/.attachments/image-898cbaf3-c8a9-4974-930e-9d2180e44983.png) Til sidst i DPS-configgen henviser den til hvor den læser excel arket fra (KFS-LAN) og hvor den indlæser dataen til (localhost, som i dette tilfælde er KMDDBS2143 - den produktionsserver, som Holbæk ligger på). ![image.png](/.attachments/image-8314d7d3-df27-4158-96f4-df0673a45663.png) DPS-Configgen ligger i produktion på KMDDBS2143 (som er produktionsserveren Holbæk ligger på), og kan findes i stien: `'f:\kmd\Config\DPS\316_maaltal_config.xml'` Det er kun vores driftsteam, som kan tilgå denne sti. Så ifb. med releasen skal du lige i samarbejde med en fra driftsteamet sikre, at DPS-configgen bliver overskrevet korrekt i denne sti. Når disse ting er ændret i modulet, så skal modulet commites og der skal pakkes en release. # Release Når vi anmoder om at få lagt en ny release på til driftsteamet, så er det vigtigt at der ligger en patch i releasen, som dropper/sletter nuværende tabeller. ![image.png](/.attachments/image-7854c63c-94c3-430a-aca0-264e92346b0c.png) ![image.png](/.attachments/image-bf12b419-8e29-40ce-b5f8-6c9050554834.png) Dette er fordi, at vi skal have nye kolonner på tabellerne, og derfor skal vi have dem slettet, førend vi kan køre de nye tabeller med nye årstal på. Derudover er det vigtigt, at DPS-Configgen også bliver overskrevet i stien, som der også blev henvist til tidligere: `'f:\kmd\Config\DPS\316_maaltal_config.xml'` Hvis releasen ikke overskriver DPS-configgen korrekt, så kan driftsteamet gå ind og manuelt tilføje den til stien. En god ide er altid lige at gemme den gamle DPS-Config, indtil man ved, at det virker med den nye. Når releasen er kørt på, så skal hele jobflowet køres - dvs. extract -> transform -> load - alternativt blot vente til næste dag, hvor det kører på schedule. # KFS-LAN Når vi har alle ovenstående dele på plads internt hos os, så skal vi have Holbæk til at uploade deres nye måltalrsark op på KFS-LAN. Dette er noget, som Holbæk selv skal gøre, og det har de styr på (dette er noget, som Keld typisk gør). Til orientering, så henter vi hos KMD fra KFS-LAN hver halve time mellem klokken 16-08 hver dag. Så hvis han uploader sit nye måltalsark klokken 09:00, så vil den først komme over i den sti, som vi benytter i DPS-configgen efter kl 16:00. Alternativt kan vi få vores interne KFS-LAN-folk til at skubbe den over til os. # TARGIT Når alt ovenstående er på plads, og jobbet er kørt i backenden, så skal jobbet også køres i TARGIT på Holbæks server. Dette er "Opus Fravær"-TARGIT jobbet. Når det er kørt, så kan det ses i TARGIT: ![Måltal Holbæk.png](/.attachments/Måltal%20Holbæk-e7272770-2985-445b-a683-f70c2fc33714.png). Nu er vi i mål, og kan få Holbæk til at teste.

path: /Technology & Software/2. Targit/2.7 Production/2.7.2 How to Upgrade a Running Solution by Implementing a Test Cube in a Customer Environment
content:
This page explains how to set up a test project to a specific solution on a customer setup, which can ensure a smooth transition from an older version of a given solution to a newer version. 

You should generally agree upon how to implement the new solution with the given PM on the project, however this can be done for various reasons, such as:
- Customer wants to test new functionalities - new measures, dimensions etc. in the new cube before fully implementing the solution
- Customer wants to ensure, that existing reports can continue to work on the new cube
- Customer is migration process where they need to have access to both the new and the old version of the solution.
- etc.

The following segments are going to show how this can be done - using Momentum in Viborg as an example:

# ETL-project

The easiest way to do this, is by copying the existing ETL-project into your solutions folder, and after this, you rename this version to "Momentum Test":
![image.png](/.attachments/image-faf28e7c-95a8-4f05-a2e2-a35a78bb07c6.png)

Proceed by opening the "Momentum_test" project.
In the ETL project you just have to make sure to change the InMemory database name, as well as the File name marked with yellow here:
![image.png](/.attachments/image-b1c45215-d024-4891-b4d9-7d8a0282cdb0.png)

For larger projects, it might also be a good idea to change to schedule to run on a different time than the "main"-project:

![image.png](/.attachments/image-d851af12-5a75-47a3-a663-c24edec291ca.png)


After this, you simply just run the project up again. 

When the job is finished, it has created a new schedule in "Targit InMemory Scheduler Management" and put a new InMemory database in the "E:\KMD\Targit\Databases\Data"-path, named "Momentum_test":

![image.png](/.attachments/image-2cf9599f-cd32-4356-bb69-9cfffb75035d.png)

This is the new database that we create a connection to in the "Targit"-section.



# Targit InMemory Scheduler Management

In this specific scenario, the test database has been put in a separate deployment folder, however it can be put in the same folder as the "Main" momentum project.
![image.png](/.attachments/image-9c991906-a6a7-452b-95ba-623c3930742e.png)

# Targit Management

Create a new connection named "Momentum_test" and add a description which showcases that this is a test version used for validation purposes:

![image.png](/.attachments/image-f0571fb9-1606-40e5-9bd3-d12e64416eea.png)

Connect to the newly made "Momentum_test"-database:

![image.png](/.attachments/image-53f5ccae-9fdf-4443-aba4-70d1d20d49e7.png)

The "Momentum_test" connection can now be seen next to the "Main" Momentum-connection

![image.png](/.attachments/image-4fd4ad4e-aac2-49be-aafc-cead6dc55869.png)

Import the datamodel to the new "Momentum_test" version and proceed by opening TARGIT.


# Targit

Now the customer can use both cubes - the older version "Momentum" marked with green and the newer version "Momentum_test" with the yellow marker:

![image.png](/.attachments/image-5f20b2ad-692a-4ffb-a52e-d17c549a4676.png)



# Final testing - helping the customers move existing a

We've created a guide which can be found in:https://kmddk.sharepoint.com/teams/TargitDevelopment-365/Delte%20dokumenter/General/Documentation/Targit%20guides%20-%20ekstern/Vejledning%20til%20at%20skifte%20kube%20p%C3%A5%20eksisterende%20analyse.pdf?CT=1705669371819&OR=ItemsView

This further explains how the customer can use existing reports and by editing the .xview file change the connection on the specific report to run on the new cube.

path: /Technology & Software/2. Targit/2.5 Installation/2.5.9 Installation af FLIS DAP
content:
[[_TOC_]]


# Overblik over opgaver ifb. implementeringen

1.	Certifikat genereres gennem https://admin.eflis.dk/administration/direkte-adgang/ (Kommunen)
        - Certifikatet skal generes til servicebrugeren
2.	Certifikat installeres på klientmaskinen som TARGIT SERVICE ACCOUNT (Kommunen/KMD)
        - Det er vigtigt, at du logger ind som service accounten og installerer certifikatet, så det ligger som personal certificate for service accounten.
3.	Opdatering af Windows Credentials Manager (Kommunen/KMD)
4.	Oprettelse af forbindelse til FLIS DAP gennem TARGIT Management (Kommunen/KMD)
5.	Aktivering af Dynamisk Tid (Kommunen/KMD)

Steps som er definereret som (Kommunen/KMD) kan begge parter udføre. Det er op til kommunen at bestemme, alt efter hvor meget hjælp de gerne vil have til implementeringen.

# 1. Certifikat genereres gennem https://admin.eflis.dk/administration/direkte-adgang/ (Kommunen). 
Dette step står kommunen for, da det kun er dem, da de skal generere certifikatet gennem FLIS administrationsportal. Det er vigtigt at certifikatet er en system bruger, og at den skal oprettes til den respektive TARGIT Service Bruger, som kører TARGIT servicen på AntServeren. Certifikatet overføres til TARGIT maskinen, og installeres i kontekst af Service Brugeren -> Step 2.

# 2. Certifikat installeres på klientmaskinen som TARGIT SERVICE ACCOUNT 

Der logges ind på TARGIT serveren som Servicebrugeren. Kommunen skal have specificeret hvor de har lagt certifikat-installationsfilen. Herefter lokaliseres certifikat-installationsfilen, hvorefter du dobbelt klikker på filen.

![image.png](/.attachments/image-4d3dfbe4-9e01-4e21-aa61-d2c949df71c8.png)

Vælg _'Aktuel Bruger'_

![image.png](/.attachments/image-e264dc76-a4f6-4850-ac22-9209af05f1a0.png)

Dobbelttjek at det er det korrekte certfikat, som importeres.

![image.png](/.attachments/image-835d0536-5586-4a7c-a012-aca68c6cb9c0.png)

Password indtastes - dette leveres af kommunen, som de får ifb. generering af certifikatet. Det er vigtigt, at der kun krydses af i nederste box.

![image.png](/.attachments/image-96009158-52ef-4370-9837-1a044841b90b.png)

Tryk "Place all certificates in the following store" hvorefter der trykkes "Browse" og vælges "Personal".

![image.png](/.attachments/image-1bca2594-f47c-4e4c-8287-eb4eba311518.png)

Afslut med "Finish".

![image.png](/.attachments/image-c397c154-5ab8-4cc8-ab36-5591e7477295.png)

Herefter skal du kunne se certifikatet under "Manage User Certificates" under Personal mappen: 

![image.png](/.attachments/image-41d0e761-216c-476e-b48c-624060ec3bc5.png)

# 3.	Opdatering af Windows Credentials Manager 

Credential Manager åbnes igennem kontrolpanelet - og under "Windows Credentials" trykkes der "Add a certificate-based credential":

![image.png](/.attachments/image-871b733b-07d4-4ea7-b04e-85b743502041.png)

Hvis dette ikke er en mulighed, skal du gå ind i "Local Security Policy" og disable følgende:

![image.png](/.attachments/image-b667ff75-f4db-4509-923f-cd00c76a1d07.png)

Når du har trykket på "Add a certificate-based credential", skal du indtaste "dataadgang.eflis.dk" og tryk på "Select Certificate" - herefter foreslår den det nyligt importerede certifikat, og der afsluttes med OK

![image.png](/.attachments/image-309be5ca-1be8-4c07-931d-643d020b2c1a.png)

Derefter skal du kunne se "dataadgang.eflis.dk" under "Certificate-Based Credentials" som herunder:

![image.png](/.attachments/image-eb0006f1-3a1a-4fb1-9f13-388023fe515a.png)

# 4.	Oprettelse af forbindelse til FLIS DAP gennem TARGIT Management

I TARGIT Management tilføjer du ny forbindelse, vælger Multidimensionel database:

![image.png](/.attachments/image-b0a376a5-9fe7-48ef-871e-c34731e0ff00.png)

"Microsoft Analysis Services Tabular (DAX)" vælges. 

![image.png](/.attachments/image-81430209-6cc4-471e-8681-7403bb043adf.png)

Indtast navnet på forbindelsen, i dette tilfælde laves der en forbindelse til FLIS DAP databasen "Statistik":

![image.png](/.attachments/image-85d6f648-785d-47ed-8f4b-618f761b18fb.png)

Indtast "https://dataadgang.eflis.dk" - det er vigtigt at "https://" er med. Herefter kan du trykke på drop down menuen under databases, og der vælges den korrekte database. 

![image.png](/.attachments/image-607b073a-8c96-47db-908c-e4f68168daed.png)

For god ordens skyld kan du teste forbindelsen til serveren, men så længe du kan se databaser i drop down menuen er det et tegn på, at der er hul igennem.

![image.png](/.attachments/image-237fe874-8305-453c-8bc8-c4c56af98ace.png)

Afslut med OK og Opret.

# 5.	Aktivering af Dynamisk Tid 

Aktivering af dynamisk tid sker pr forbindelse igennem "Decorations" i TARGIT Management: 

![image.png](/.attachments/image-330c4a78-0152-4e20-a143-aef79d447173.png)

Start med at tryk "Show only specified decorations" af:
![image.png](/.attachments/image-f0118bdc-e4c8-4e7c-99e3-2a9fd6ad5f6f.png)

Herefter kan du se alle databaser: 


![image.png](/.attachments/image-efa77b94-d539-4f79-b05f-8cdd6f293908.png)
Lokaliser dine FLIS DAP databaser, hvorefter man udfolder og finder "Tid"-dimensionen, trykker på hierarkiet her, som fx "År - Kvartal - Måned". Herefter trykker du på værdien i "Value" under "Dynamic dates definition" (herunder står der "Unspecified" og markeret med gult):
![image.png](/.attachments/image-7b9659c2-f94a-4075-9e9a-2388c03691b5.png)

Herefter skal man definere "Definition":
![image.png](/.attachments/image-faf445cb-dc32-4a3e-aced-137b65353ffb.png)

Samt under "Level type overrides" tilføjes således det passer til hierarkiet/definitionen. I dette tilfælde er det et "År - Kvartal - Måned"-hierarki, og derfor tilføjes disse i denne rækkefølge under "Add":
![image.png](/.attachments/image-e7d13bb8-02e5-418b-a60a-0cf8aeae6f98.png)

Dette skal gøres for alle Tids hierarkier i diverse tids dimensioner på tværs af alle FLIS DAP forbindelserne.

Derefter er FLIS DAP implementeret.

## Definitioner på diverse hierarki typer

**År - Halvår - Kvartal - Måned**

`[<YYYY>].&[H<H>].&[K<Q>].[<Januar|Februar|Marts|April|Maj|Juni|Juli|August|September|Oktober|November|December>]`

**År - Kvartal - Måned**

`[<YYYY>].&[K<Q>].[<Januar|Februar|Marts|April|Maj|Juni|Juli|August|September|Oktober|November|December>]`

**År - Måned**

`[<YYYY>].[<Januar|Februar|Marts|April|Maj|Juni|Juli|August|September|Oktober|November|December>]`

**År - Uge**

`[<YYYY>].&[<W>]`

**År - Måned - Uge - Dato**
`[<YYYY>].[<Januar|Februar|Marts|April|Maj|Juni|Juli|August|September|Oktober|November|December>].&[<W>].[<DD-MM-YYYY>]`

**År**
`[<YYYY>]`

**Måned**
`[<Januar|Februar|Marts|April|Maj|Juni|Juli|August|September|Oktober|November|December>]`

**Dato**
`[<DD-MM-YYYY>]`

path: /Technology & Software/1. SAPBO/1.3 IDT (Information Design Tool)/1.3.4 Servers and Connections
content:
**Intro**
From IDT we have several connections to the IQ servers, where we host our data. Both IDT and IQ has a development (dev) and production (prod) environment. When using IDT we have the opportunity to connect to universes published on both dev and prod - and the respective connections to the IQ server. 

**Development**
When using IDT in development you can retrieve and publish universes trough the BO dev server (ip...). As default the universe has a connection to the IQ development server (connection: IQ2). If you wish to connect to data in production, you can change the connection _temporary_ to the IQ production server (connection: IQ2_Prod). In that case it's important to change the connection back to IQ2 before publishing the universe to production.

Server and connections:
- BO Server:
- IQ development connection: IQ2
- IQ production connection: IQ2_Prod

**Production**
When a universe is published to production, the IQ2 connection points to the IQ production server.

Server and connections:
- BO Server:
- IQ production connection_ IQ2

**Connection to SQL server (customer specific)**
Some customers have an individual SQL server (e.g. Esbjerg municipality) with the need to connect from IDT to SQL. In that case a customer specific connection is made (e.q. SQL_Esbjerg).

path: /Technology & Software/1. SAPBO/1.3 IDT (Information Design Tool)/1.3.1 Get Started
content:
Responsible: BFL

This guide applies to the creation of new universes. However, it’s also desirable to adapt “old” universes as much as possible according to the current guide. Universes are built and maintained in SAP BO’s “Information Design Tool”. Universes represent the semantic layer where technical terms, tables, and fields are translated into business language. Additionally, database data is supplemented with filters that intuitively help end-users to limit the data basis. The extension for universes is .UNX.

Master Universe: To reduce complexity and facilitate development and future maintenance, a “master universe” is built over time. In addition to the master universe for time, the following masters have been created: Citizen and Structure, Hierarchies, Salary and Personnel, Age Intervals, Time and Clock Time. These are merely templates, but naming, etc., should be used from these universes. These dimensions are not used for all universes.

In the master universe, there will be a wide range of common objects that can easily be used by each universe designer. In the master universe, individual objects are available along with object descriptions (mouse-over) and formatting. Thus, cross-cutting objects or classes can be copied directly into a new universe. As common objects/filters are approved as “cross-cutting”, they are placed in a master universe. In this description, the cross-cutting universes are referred to as (M) for master.

Changing an Existing Universe: The universe is downloaded from the development environment under the master folder. It’s good practice to always start by downloading it, even if you already have it in your IDT project. The universe may have been edited in the meantime.

There are additional settings in the master universe that ensure that when it is used, we are confident that these settings are correct. This applies, for example, to ANSI standards, row restrictions, and the like. This ensures a high degree of consistency and reliability in our data management.

You can access the official documentation for the Information Design Tool through this link [KMD DATA - DMBI - (365) - Information design tool guide.pdf - All Documents](https://kmddk.sharepoint.com/sites/DIMALG-365/Delte%20dokumenter/Forms/AllItems.aspx?isAscending=false&sortField=LinkFilename&web=1&FolderCTID=0x01200082B4A5B097F59D48B6D59F3F61A67BEF&id=%2Fsites%2FDIMALG%2D365%2FDelte%20dokumenter%2FGeneral%2FKMDBI%2EFiles%2FTechnology%20%26%20Software%2F1%2E%20SAPBO%2FInformation%20design%20tool%20guide%2Epdf&viewid=cacafc2b%2Dc288%2D4478%2Db2fd%2D66b398234212&parent=%2Fsites%2FDIMALG%2D365%2FDelte%20dokumenter%2FGeneral%2FKMDBI%2EFiles%2FTechnology%20%26%20Software%2F1%2E%20SAPBO). It provides comprehensive information and guidance on how to use the tool effectively. If you have any questions or need further assistance, feel free to ask! 😊
