content:
## **Properties/description/* in Business layer**

Changes in the universe are “logged” in Properties (Business layer) and Description (Table properties). The format is to note a date for the change and what has been modified. This allows users to see the changes made in the universe.
```
Date – Description Nov 2024 – Employee number, measure on hours 
```

Special considerations in the universe, important for those working with it, are specified under the “Comments” tab in the Business Layer. This means that any unique assumptions about the universe are documented.

Comments in “Properties” are included in extracts of universe content and form part of the documentation provided to customers. Note: This does not apply to comments in “description” and “comments”; they are not included in the documentation.

Only one year of history is stored.

path: /Technology & Software/1. SAPBO/1.3 IDT (Information Design Tool)/1.3.7 Best Practice/Measure Configuration
content:
Generally, we use sum and count measures.

Delegated Measures:
Coined as “intelligent measures”, e.g., “number of people (i)” They can be used when you want a unique calculation in all contexts, for example, in the calculation of the number of people.

Please note that delegated measures do not work in all functionalities in SAP. For example, Drill will not work appropriately, as it needs to be recalculated every time a drill is performed.

Average:
The average generally does not work optimally in IDT, as you have to be very aware of the context in which it is calculated. The reason for this is that the average is calculated as a simple average instead of a weighted average. We therefore recommend having a numerator and a denominator, making it easy for users to calculate an average correctly.

Count:
Count counts in the query. If predefined measures are to be used, it is therefore essential to only include the objects that you want to count on in the query. 

Requirements to be followed:
“Sum” must always be added around the measure. This ensures that the calculation is performed on the database and significantly improves performance.

When creating measures, it is very important to specify how the measure should aggregate in both the Project Function and down in the Select syntax. This ensures that the SQL, generated in BO, works as intended. As you can see from the screenshot below, the Project Function has been changed to sum at the same time as there is sum() around the measure.

As a rule, a measure should never be database-delegated in the Project Function, as it means that the report has to be updated every time the context changes.

![Billede1.png](/.attachments/Billede1-3635ff16-c717-446f-aeda-b828849579a9.png)

path: /Technology & Software/1. SAPBO/1.3 IDT (Information Design Tool)/1.3.7 Best Practice/Directories
content:
# Mapper i Business Layer.

The construction of the path structure in the universe must be designed to ensure the highest degree of user-friendliness, and recognizable across the universes.

All objects must contain an exhaustive description of the object as mouseover text, preferably with an example of a value in the object. Remember that this mouseover text is included as documentation for the universe and for data extraction.

## Cross-cutting classes:
The cross-cutting time objects “Year”, “Month” etc. are placed in a folder of their own, named “Tid”. The “Klokkeslet” folder is placed under time Filters regarding time are placed in the time folder.

The “Time” folder is always placed at the top of the pathfinder structure
Remember that master_universe_Time contains a full time folder

##Other typical cross-cutting classes: 
-Person / employee
-Economic dimensions, chart of accounts

The cross-cutting classes/objects are added to the master universe on an ongoing basis.

##General
Class :"Generelt": should be placed at the bottom.

Included in all universes and contains the following (example): It should be made clear in the description of these objects that they do not concern the other objects in the universe, which is why it is recommended that these objects be placed in a separate query.

##Metrics 
Metrics as a starting point, they are placed in a class of their own, and secondly at the bottom of the path structure. If certain metrics can only be used with selected dimensions, it should be apparent from the folder naming.

##Filters: 
Here are collected the filters that are relevant in the given universe.

##Other classes 
Other classes are named and grouped according to business concepts. Group and name dimensions, if there are limitations in which metrics they can be combined with.

Example of path structure construction:
![image.png](/.attachments/image-1b823e20-253a-4011-afc9-8fd871047373.png)

![image.png](/.attachments/image-4a92a3c9-dfbf-4f92-9d32-4537a8a75c7d.png)

# Hierarchies:

If filters are developed on hierarchies, the filter should be placed at the bottom of the folder structure, for the sake of the drill functionality in SAP BO. You can also place the lowest level in the folder hierarchy (for example here “capital funds”) to prevent Drill in SAP BO from failing when you perform a drill “at the bottom”.

Normal practice is to show 12 levels (OPUS) unless the professional system gives rise to a smaller number of levels.

![image.png](/.attachments/image-7b0db4f0-4568-4999-a163-9a25827f3010.png)

When creating the filter object, you should first create a List of Values (LOV). Choose 12 levels as the default. The functionality can be found under “Parameters and List of Values”.

![image.png](/.attachments/image-8786705f-3680-454c-9d8f-266c4bf10ee2.png)

When the object is selected, it is recommended that selected is at level 12, but in practice, it has been shown not to matter.

![image.png](/.attachments/image-9d119ecd-7bbb-4cdc-88f5-05e7bec774c3.png)

Finally, set the maximum drill level under Advanced - LOV. See the screenshot below. If another level is chosen, for example, level 2, then the maximum level users can drill to when they view it in the report will be level 2. The default choice will be level 12, but there may be professional reasons to choose, for example, level 6.

![image.png](/.attachments/image-33ee3286-a397-4f32-aff5-4572ae66e1b5.png)

path: /Technology & Software/1. SAPBO/1.3 IDT (Information Design Tool)/1.3.7 Best Practice/Aggregate Awareness
content:
When poor performance is experienced on large datasets, the solution is often to introduce aggregate awareness (AA), so that the entire dataset does not have to be pulled.

Aggregate awareness can also be used if you want different levels of detail in relation to time. An example could be that a voucher number should only be shown for the current year, but not further back in time. That is, if you use the voucher number in the query, it will not be possible to get a 5-year history.

If a solution needs aggregate awareness, the recommendation is that there should be 2 "aggregates":

a) "All". This ensures optimal performance if you "forget" the time dimension in the query.
b) 1 aggregated (This could, for example, be a month)

Whether there is a need for more aggregated tables such as year, quarter, week, day depends on the amount of data and the dataset. If there is no need for a week aggregate table, it should not be added.

**How does it work:**
The use of aggregated tables increases the speed of SQL queries. Aggregate awareness means that objects are aggregated in relation to the different time dimensions such as year, month, week, etc. Thus, queries that use aggregated objects will return information in aggregated form much faster.

There can be different time histories on the various aggregated tables. That is, daily fact can be a 3-month history, Year and month fact full history.

Remember to use Views in IDT, as it makes the overview of Aggregate Awareness easier.

**Pitfalls:**
Incorrect setup of “Alias and Contexts” (data foundation) can result in errors.

“Set Aggregate Navigation” (business layer) should be set for each individual fact. A checked dimension will not be used in the respective fact.

![image.png](/.attachments/image-c7b20f76-42d7-4784-8539-27245c0bd3aa.png)

path: /Technology & Software/1. SAPBO/1.3 IDT (Information Design Tool)/1.3.7 Best Practice/Business Layer Setup
content:
We are currently considering whether we will introduce more business layers on a large scale in a universe. This adds some extra complexity to the universe, as it will contain multiple contexts. But it has clear advantages, for example, with objects that occur in all universes, they only need to be changed in one place.

It is advantageous for the end user, as there is no need to merge things across universes. We are also considering the possibility of using subqueries in these universes instead of query by query, which will have a significant impact on the performance.

An update will come when we are ready with an announcement.

path: /Technology & Software/2. Targit/2.12 Tips and Tricks/2.12.4 Ragged Hierarchies
content:
#Description
Targit supports ragged hierarchies that will display only levels that contain data as expandable.
The presentation makes for much easier understanding of hierarchical data and should be implemented everywhere possible.

#Front-end and datamodel
This example shows the Adm Org Hiearchy on 657 that have different depth.

![image.png](/.attachments/image-3d4f5043-cda2-4292-b670-f73de9ba0d9d.png)
Because they are the only parts of the tree that have data for that level, there are lots of empty "-" lines.

The **Ragged hierarchy depth column** in datamodel finetunes the data presentation.

In this example that has been done for "Adm org lang" using the field **AdmOrgDepth**

![image.png](/.attachments/image-dbdcbe02-da05-40bf-a717-eda45ce78257.png)
_To define this field, it must be dragged on top of the value part of the property using the mouse._


###Now the presentation of the same parts of the hierarchy looks like this
![image.png](/.attachments/image-43f2382e-d31a-4f73-8fb4-9cce8721b87a.png)
Its shorter and more concise and makes for much easier navigation.

##ETL
The ETL project must contain code that _generates the depth columns_.

This is done in the "Load dimensions and facts part" of the standard ETL package.

![image.png](/.attachments/image-1e571c84-ad9e-4eca-9c15-cded3774c616.png)

The code for calculating the various Dim_Konto field depths for ØS2 model is added to the load of the Dim_Konto table:
![image.png](/.attachments/image-6802fb61-3aa6-4f54-8c26-f7af8018ffe4.png)

The code part is pasted in here so it can be copied to other projects.
``` sql
/* Depth columns for ragged hierarchy property */
,case when F1KODE = '' and F2KODE = '' then 0 when F2KODE = '' then 1 when F3KODE = '' then 2 when F4KODE = '' then 3 when F5KODE = '' then 4 when F6KODE = '' then 5 else 6 end as FunktionDepth
,case when S1KODE = '' and S2KODE = '' then 0 when S2KODE = '' then 1 when S3KODE = '' then 2 when S4KODE = '' then 3 when S5KODE = '' then 4 when S6KODE = '' then 5 when S7KODE = '' then 6 else 7 end as StedDepth
,case when G1KODE = '' and G2KODE = '' then 0 when G2KODE = '' then 1 when G3KODE = '' then 2 when G4KODE = '' then 3 else 4 end as GrupperingDepth
,case when A1KODE = '' and A2KODE = '' then 0 when A2KODE = '' then 1 when A3KODE = '' then 2 when A4KODE = '' then 3 else 4 end as ArtDepth
,case when O1KODE = '' and O2KODE = '' then 0 when O2KODE = '' then 1 when O3KODE = '' then 2 when O4KODE = '' then 3 when O5KODE = '' then 4 else 5 end as AdmOrgDepth
,case when P1KODE = '' and P2KODE = '' then 0 when P2KODE = '' then 1 when P3KODE = '' then 2 when P4KODE = '' then 3 when P5KODE = '' then 4 else 5 end as PolOrgDepth
,case when R1KODE = '' and R2KODE = '' then 0 when R2KODE = '' then 1 when R3KODE = '' then 2 when R4KODE = '' then 3 when R5KODE = '' then 4 else 5 end as ProjektDepth
,case when X1KODE = '' and X2KODE = '' then 0 when X2KODE = '' then 1 when X3KODE = '' then 2 when X4KODE = '' then 3 else 4 end as ValgfriXDepth
,case when Z1KODE = '' and Z2KODE = '' then 0 when Z2KODE = '' then 1 when Z3KODE = '' then 2 when Z4KODE = '' then 3 when Z5KODE = '' then 4 else 5 end as ValgfriZDepth
```

# When developing
Development could be anywhere. On the developers own machine (using KMDPFOSAP\zxxxx) or on a develop server. The Targit Development server is recommended (KMDAPP0138 - 172.31.112.36).

The package should at all times be developed and tested on a dev machine, before releasing to customers. The dev machine should therefore be configured as a full Targit server, with an InMemory database, Targit Scheduler management, and Targit Analysis for testing purposes. And as mentioned above, the naming in the TargitSources.csv file should be equal on all machines used for development and production - ie. Solution and Environment should be present in all environments where the package could be deployed.

It is the developers responsibility to ensure this, but a little help is provided. You can see all solutions from all customers in the new 'Targit Sources' report on the operations portal and check if the customer already have the required solution entry.

![image.png](/.attachments/image-f01a5848-dc5d-4dab-a363-b9b74fa0e51d.png)

## Development profile configuration
* *See [Deployment Tool](https://dev.azure.com/kmd-dima/KMD.DIMA.LG/_wiki/wikis/KMD.DIMA.LG.wiki/6425/Deployment-Tool) for guided deployment. It is not neccesary to use profiles when using the tool.*

During development deployment should be to a ‘Development’ profile.

![image.png](/.attachments/image-e3f80783-cb2c-4939-9656-926eb7ebb7c7.png)

This profile could point to localhost or an ip address to the development server if development is done otherwhere. The directory should be your own personal development folder. On the Targit development server this should alway be a deployment folder named with your initials for easy reference.

This will deploy the ETL package into the Targit Scheduler System as normal. You should have seen this before, otherwise reach out to PDT3.

After development and testing is done – release to production can be made.

path: /Technology & Software/2. Targit/2.3 Deployment/2.3.2 When Releasing to Production
content:
# When releasing to production

## Solution variables
**Before releasing, please check that the @Solution and @Environment variables are present at the customer side**. The easiest way to make sure of this is to use a standard naming for all solutions at all customers. You can find the variables in the ‘Set configurations [MANUALLY]’ box that should be present in your Targit project like below.

![image.png](/.attachments/image-abd033c5-5956-4743-9938-a49f8009627b.png)


## Production profile configuration
* *See [Deployment Tool](https://dev.azure.com/kmd-dima/KMD.DIMA.LG/_wiki/wikis/KMD.DIMA.LG.wiki/6425/Deployment-Tool) for alternative release method. It is not neccesary to use profiles when using the tool.*

The ‘Production’ deployment environment should be set up to deliver files to a ‘Production’ deployment folder. This is not a Targit folder or a folder i Targit Scheduler Management, but a regular folder on the Targit development server. You can choose any folder for deploying, but preferbly keep it within your own KMDWORK folder.

In this example a 'Release' folder under the KMDWORK\MCC folder is chosen.

![image.png](/.attachments/image-259df704-e2e7-4e07-8682-a44af0b0b691.png)








  
## Change project name and deployment configuration
When releasing a project to production change deployment setting from 'Development' to 'Production'. This should leave an *.impd file with your solution name in your chosen release folder.

Locate and copy your datamodel file (we recommend using the vsCode ViewTargitConnections powershell script) and paste it in your relase folder as well.

Rename both files to [Customernumber][solution].[type] like this

![image.png](/.attachments/image-576a5563-bda3-4a3f-8f2f-23c1406c83da.png)

Do this for both ETL (impd) and datamodel (XML)

Now you files are ready for releasing. To relase copy them to the folder:

* D:\KMD\Targit\Deployment




Please remember that released solutions should have NO schedules. Please remove any schedules before releasing to production.



# Automatic deployment on customers server.
The deployment to the customer server will happen automatically during the day.
The IMPD package will be deployed immediately. But the datamodel will only be deployed within 5 minutes of the the IMPD file being successfully run.

A PowerShell script keeps surveillance with the production deployment folder and updates the deployment database in KMD. The script is deploying using the customer number in the filename, so the number is important.

Accordingly, a customer side script updates the customers Production folder. This is a Targit Schedule folder containing all packages to the customer.

For each package there will be a corresponding ConditionalRun package at the customers server, so no scheduling in the solution package!!

Please note that an initial procedure from PDT3 is required before any new solutions can be deployed. Please reach out.

path: /Technology & Software/2. Targit/2.3 Deployment/2.3.6 Configuration on KMD site – TARGIT Platform
content:
# Configuration on KMD site – PDT3
All deployment information should be maintained in the [kmdbi].[TargitDeployDistribution] table.
![image.png](/.attachments/image-dc6b60f3-eae9-4dc0-b6cf-cb7b8dcf7b6d.png)

The table is primarily populated of a powershell script, but information about the ConnectionID folder should be added to the table by the person who is installing.
When a new Customer/Solution combination is added to the table, please:
Run the stored procedure [kmdbi].[Targit_NewTargitDeploySolution] or [kmdbi].[Targit_NewTargitDeploySolution_NoConnectionID] (Preferred)
You need the customer number and the name of the solution.
If you run the _NoConnectionID stored procudure you dont need to know the connection id and it will create 1 line for the impd file and one for each connectionID this has. 

This will do the following

1. Add IsActive, Customer, Solution, Type
2. Add ConnectionID to the Datamodel entries (folder id from Customers connection folder)

Then you need to run the powershell script ("DeploySolutions" or "Deployment Tool") to fill in the rest of the fields.

Use [Deployment Tool](https://dev.azure.com/kmd-dima/KMD.DIMA.LG/_wiki/wikis/KMD.DIMA.LG.wiki/6425/Deployment-Tool) if you have a ready solution installed on the .36/.87 server.
Otherwise you need to manually collect the impd file and datamodel from the customer.

These needs to be placed on the .36 server at the following path:
```
D:\KMD\Targit\Deployment
```
They must both be renamed with the following syntax:
```
[MunicipalityNumber][Solution].xml / [Kommunenr][Solution].impd
```
![image.png](/.attachments/image-84b3d41d-8a14-43ee-be07-15fe08f416f4.png)

Then you can either wait for a job that runs every 30 minutes (07:55/08:25 and so on) or run it manually:

![image.png](/.attachments/image-b2b0a0a2-3dc2-422e-8186-acd17e6d09e6.png)

Then the customer has been fully set up for autodeploymen on our side.
See [Customer setup](https://dev.azure.com/kmd-dima/KMD.DIMA.LG/_wiki/wikis/KMD.DIMA.LG.wiki/6461/Customer-setup) for how to then set it up on the customer side.

#Special case - multiple datamodels for one ETL package
This describes what to do if you have multiple solutions for one ETL Package. 

This will be done for you if you used the "_NoConnectionID" stored procedure to create the lines.
***Except if you don't have an AnalysisDatabase name in the Datamodels.***

![image.png](/.attachments/image-eece9d9f-d655-4777-bdae-010322aa381a.png)
Opus Loenopfoelgning has got 2 connections using 2 different datamodels.
To ensure proper functioning you need to manually change the "AnalysisDatabase" such that the name of the AnalysisDatabase is the same as the name of the AnalysisDatabase of the Datamodel.xml file:
![image.png](/.attachments/image-6ea30afc-4eec-4274-b06b-e15cd04ca8bc.png)

You can run the following sql query on KDIPMSSDB08 to get the names:
```sql
SELECT [Customer]
      ,[InMemoryDatabase]
      ,[id]
      ,[ConnectionName]
      ,[ConnectionDescription]
      ,[ETLPackage]
      ,[ExtensionName]
  FROM [KMDBI_03_DM].[kmdbi].[TargitDatamodelVersions]
  where Customer = '746' and InMemoryDatabase = 'Opus Loenopfoelgning'
```
Just replace customer and InMemoryDatabase
![image.png](/.attachments/image-7c739404-1f18-429d-b5cb-1003e0bfac78.png)
"id" is the connectionID
"ExtensionName" is the analysisDatabase name.

If you have not named the analysisDatabase. You need to do so to support multiple datamodels for one ETL package.

path: /Technology & Software/2. Targit/2.3 Deployment/2.3.4 Execution of New Or Updated Packages
content:
# Execution of new or updated packages
There are 3 scenarios when a package is updated and deployed.
1. We do not want an immediate update of data. The IMPD file and Datamodel file are deployed to the customer server and the regular data IMPD will be run when new data is available.
1. If we have a special schedule that runs e.g. once a week, we might want to enforce the update of the changed IMPD file when deploying. You can run the "Execute Customer IMPD" located on the .36 server to execute a deployed IMPD file manually.

1. If no changes are made to the deployment files but we want an execution of a package, you can run the "Execute Customer IMPD" located on the .36 server to execute a deployed IMPD file manually.

path: /Technology & Software/2. Targit/2.3 Deployment/2.3.3 Deployment for Support Tasks
content:
# Deployment for Support tasks
One benefit of the new deployment functionality is that it allows you to redeploy the latest release to our Targit development server, creating an exact replica of what’s currently running on the customer’s server.

This only works on KMDAPP0138/172.31.112.36.

As always there is a few reuirements that must be met to make the process work.

## Requirements
1. Your solution must have been deployed to a customer using the automatic deployment tool. Check with PDT3 if that is the case.
1. On the support server there must be an entry in the ‘TargitSources.csv’ file that points to the relevant customer/solution on DATAOUT. (eg. 791Momentum|PROD)
1. You must have a preprepared CONNECTION in Targit Management on the support server with the name ‘SUPPORT[INITIALS]’ where [INITIALS] must be replaced with your initials. The setup up of this connection can be made with the help of TARGIT Platform.


The initial process is manual – so far. If the use of support solutions catches on, we might consider to move the processes into a portal.

## Ordering a support solution update

1. Make sure that the requirements are met.
2. Run the powershell script: "Support Deployment" located on the desktop of .36
3. The script will notify you when the deployment and load of data is done.

The design is to have one setup per consultant. 

This means that you can run one solution at a time. We reuse the solution, so that you always, after requiring new data, only need to log into the Support solution with your name (eg. ‘SUPPORT MCC’)

Support solution databases will be deleted after 7 days. So if you still need the data you will have to load it in again.

If you can get hold of a customer analysis and want to use it on your support solution, please open the xview file in notepad and edit the database connection through the whole file.

The connection info looks like this:

>> <metadata database="746 OPUS Løn og Personale" cube="Opus Løn og Personale - Fravær"/>

It is only the ’database= ‘ that should be changed from the customers databasename to your SUPPORTxxx connection name.

path: /Technology & Software/2. Targit/2.12 Tips and Tricks/2.12.3 Wiki Documentation Tips
content: #Azure DevOps wiki features The wiki part of Azure DevOps supports "Markdown with mermaid". ##Markdown Markdown is an easy way to enhance text presentations with an easy to use extended syntax for creating tables, code blocks and more. This is done directly in the text editor and makes for very nice presentations. # Introduction

Translations used in KY are delivered on standard KY SFTP, in Excel file. Translations for all customers are present in one file, therefore all are loaded to global module. 

As there is no Excel installed on production servers, the file is fetched and loaded using .NET 4.7.6 application. For the future it may be worth to consider PowerShell module https://www.powershellgallery.com/packages/ImportExcel/7.8.6 instead of using .NET.

# Implementation

.NET module copies Excel file from SFTP, reads it and loads directly to extract tables.  

Then using modified DSA_SSIS_LS_GENERIC project data is loaded to archive tables. Modification in SSIS ignores loading to extract tables, as data is already present there. Then it loads data from extract to archive in standard way. 

Tables from excel are:
- PARAMETERATTRIBUT
- PARAMETERINSTANS
- PARAMETERTYPE
- PARAMETERVAERDI
- PARAMETERVAERDI_K
- TEKST

In procedure [archive].[postDSA_Load] data from archive table is aggregated and loaded into table [archive].[parameterInstansTranslations]. This aggregation is implemented in DSA because because it is much more efficient. If this operation was implemented in customer dataareas modules it lasts over 30 minutes, directly in DSA it last for less then 20 seconds. It is due to using Linked Servers, as all data has to be downloaded from Linked Server. Running query on DSA doesn't require downloading.

# Implementation in customers edw modules

Synonyms leading to global_dsa_ky are in schema config, they lead to archive tables.

Translations are used in edw in few different ways. In procedure [stage].[preDataArea_Update] 4 tables are populated basing on the global_dsa_ky and 2 tables from customer dsa module: [archive].[ParameterinstansKH] and [archive].[TEKSTH].

- [config].[TekstTranslations]
- [config].[LOCALTEKST]
- [config].[parameterInstansTranslationsKommune_mv]
- [config].[parameterInstansTranslations_mv]

These 4 tables and synonym [config].[TEKST] are used to find translations in stored procedures.

# Introduction
To help with working / administrating Targit connections, especially on servers with lots of connections we have developed a helping tool.

The script runs through the 'Connections.xml' file from the Targit Antserver folder and provide an overview together with some other nifty features.

The tool is created in PowerShell and must be run through Visual Studio Code to give the full experience. For those of you, that are not used to work with Visual Studio Code please read the requirements section through.

# Requirements
To run PowerShell scripts you must trust either the specific file or the entire folder where the script lives.

Therefore, you will be prompted with a warning when you open a new file or a file from a folder you have not earlier trusted.

![ps restricted mode.png](/.attachments/ps%20restricted%20mode-1ddc7340-1483-4ba8-91aa-777cd6c555ee.png)

Click on 'Manage'. This will bring you to a window, where you can decide between trusting the file or add a folder to trust.


![ps trust mode.png](/.attachments/ps%20trust%20mode-9e51bbd4-b57c-45ac-9706-ac1ea86e6f9c.png)

All this will happen after you open the script.

# View Targit Connections

The script is normally placed on the Desktop for all users on the servers. If you are missing the script please reach out to PDT3.

![image.png](/.attachments/image-07ab9a83-fa6b-49af-9f43-a739a192e0ca.png)

Right click the image and select 'Open with Code'. Please remember that the script only works in VS Code.


If you haven't earlier worked with PowerShell i Visual Studio Code, you will be prompted to install the PowerShell extension. Click 'Install'

![vsc install ps.png](/.attachments/vsc%20install%20ps-baa978fc-d590-4484-afe8-1cae6bd47de0.png) 

Now you should see something like this:

![image.png](/.attachments/image-a8249c7c-928e-4dd5-a41d-da8947b7b990.png)

##Option:

The script will per standard not show connections that are not enabled, but you have the posibility to overrule that.

Changing the '$filterconnections' from true to false will give you all connections.

Hit F5 to run the script.

The script returns a datatable like this.

![image.png](/.attachments/image-6d9fc76d-9f1d-41b3-8102-08570454f183.png)

It will show the connection, the connection folder,  description + a few other attributes. The attribute list may be subject to changes.

For an easy access to the Connections datamodel folder rest the mouse on the relevant 'Connection folder' line and 'Ctrl+click'. This opens a new VS Code window. You could be met with more Trust requirements here. We advice to trust all files and folders in the Targit connection folder.

![image.png](/.attachments/image-f8ab4107-25fa-4491-b39b-45e02a0b5cee.png)

From here you have imidiate access to the files in the solution folder from the left side menu.

You can chose to view the current Datamodel.xml:

![image.png](/.attachments/image-7a0739ed-ef0c-4680-ae74-41e2721c01e5.png)

You can view database information:

![image.png](/.attachments/image-ddf32c8b-a2c7-4235-9f2f-e847dfeed3f0.png)

And you can even compare Datamodels with the backups Targit automatically creates when you use their datamodel editor.

![image.png](/.attachments/image-de09ac0a-1471-4c8d-9bb7-8f4101bb5ef0.png)

If you need access to the folder, eg. to copy the Datamodel file, you just right click the file and select 'Reveal in File Explorer'

path: /Teams/1. Administrative Domain Team/1.4 PRISME365/1.4.2 Integration mellem SD og PRISME365
content:
[[_TOC_]]


Integrationen mellem SD og PRISME365 understøttes ved hjælp af en modifikationer til SD-ETL samt en PRISME365-Extension.



# Forudsætninger:
På nuværende tidspunkt er planen, at kunne understøtte to versioner af integrationen:

- BYOD-server leveret af Fujitsu (lavet til Viborg) **mangler lige at putte det i svn, men det ligger lokalt i Viborg**
- .csv-leverance (FMK som eksempel)


# BYOD:
Hvis integrationen laves pba. af BYOD'en vil der være behov for installation af modulerne:


**DSA_PRISME365** --> Indlæsning fra BYOD

**EDW_PRISME365COMMON** --> Common modulet som indeholder tabellerne vi har brug for til at lave integrationen

Tabellerne er som følger:

- Tabeller, der bruges i datamodellen
  - **Fact_vForbrug_incl_Prisme365** - view, som erstatter _[sdloen].[Fact_Forbrug]_. Viewet indeholder PRISME365's _"DW_SK_Konto"_, som bruges til at joine på PRISME365 _"Dimension_Konto"_.
Dette view kan findes i SVN under SDLOEN-modulet.
  - **Dimension_Konto** - indeholder den fulde kontoplan
  - **Dimension_DefaultHierarki** - indeholder organisationshierarkiet
  - **Dimension_AfledtDimHierarki** - indeholder afledte dimensioner - typisk politiske organisation

- Tabeller, der bruges til joins (enten i backenden eller i TARGIT)
  - **Dimension_FinansKontoAlias** - indeholder SD afdelingskode, benyttes til at lave kobling til SD
  - **Fact_IF_KontoFinansKontoAfledtDimension** - indeholder nøgler der kan koble konto sammen med de afledte dimensioner
  - **Fact_IF_KontoFinansKontoDimensionAlias** - indeholder P365's "DW_SK_Konto" og "DW_SK_FinansKontoAlias" - benyttes til at koble PRISME365 kontoen på viewet (_Fact_vForbrug_incl_Prisme365_)


# .CSV-leverance:

I skrivende stund har vi opgaven med integrationen vha. Csv-fil indlæsning på tegnebrættet for FMK, hvor vi er i en afklaringsproces om indlæsningen. Skal vi indlæse .csv-filen i backenden eller blot i TARGIT ETL'en?
Herudover er der andre obs punkter:

- Vi har ingen DW_SK_Nøgler, som vi får, hvis vi bruger PRISME365 modulerne (BYOD), så vi skal joine på naturlige nøgler (Afdelingskoder)
- Struktur og navngivning skal passes til, og en skabelon laves 
- Strukturen i csv-filen matcher ikke 1:1 det, som vi læser ind i TARGIT
- Navngivningen i csv-filen matcher ikke 1:1 det, som vi har fra vores P365 modul (og de navne, som vi bruger til indlæsningen i TARGIT).


# ETL 

ETL'en er på nuværende tidspunkt lavet ud fra et BYOD-perspektiv. Det understøtter PT ikke CSV-indlæsningen.


![image.png](/.attachments/image-8b0fffee-8f67-4521-a2f4-1b5d356b24d9.png)


## Fact
**IF @dsFINANCE = 'PRISME' THEN**...:

Hvis @dsFINANCE sættes til 'PRISME' i toppen af ETL'en, vil den indlæse viewet, som beskrevet i ovenstående sektion.

![image.png](/.attachments/image-286301d6-f7d5-44f0-af2f-c19968605968.png)


**IF @dsFINANCE <> 'PRISME' THEN**...:

Hvis @dsFINANCE er forskelling fra 'PRISME', indlæser den blot _SDLOEN.Fact_Forbrug_ som normalt.

![image.png](/.attachments/image-898460c6-500c-42a3-8483-4e66b7ca566a.png)

## Konto

**DimKonto** - vi indlæser PRISME365s dimension_Konto, som indeholder kontoplanens elementer.
![image.png](/.attachments/image-41512e34-dc9e-4322-a761-a982c3287b37.png)
![image.png](/.attachments/image-a05f3553-5c68-437b-9d1f-74cfed7fceff.png)


**AfledtDimHierarki** - vi indlæser de afledte dimensioner, som typisk indeholder kommunens politiske organisation - vi laver her et join i ETL-pakken, så vi kan få en DW_SK_Konto nøgle med, som vi bruger til kobling i datamodellen.
![image.png](/.attachments/image-e23bbfe6-80da-4602-9b7a-e218407ca724.png)

**DimDefaultHierarki** - vi bliver her nødt til at bruge en naturlig nøgle til kobling i datamodellen, nemlig "Afdelingskode", som vi finder som en del af Dim_Konto, og så ligger den som en del af det organisatoriske hierarki. 
I hierarkiet ligger afdelingskoden på det nederste niveau, hvorfor vi bliver nødt til at lave en coalesce()
![image.png](/.attachments/image-8bb36270-0db1-4472-af7b-8cdca70cb279.png)
![image.png](/.attachments/image-f66bb8d3-9bfd-4b1f-b9a4-355b9b42f354.png)



# Datamodel og extension

Integrationen er lavet som en extension til datamodellen ved navn "PRISME365".

Her kobles:

Fact_Forbrug.DW_SK_Konto -> Dim_Konto.DW_SK_Konto
Dim_Konto.Afdelingskode  -> Dim_DefaultHierarki.Afdelingskode
Fact_Forbrug.DW_SK_Konto -> Dim_AfledtDimHierarki.DW_SK_Konto


![image.png](/.attachments/image-7d07f939-ca72-4085-a24f-839304c56e23.png)


#FMKs excel fil
FMKs csv fil har kun to faner:
![image.png](/.attachments/image-893e1d94-e795-4de1-8167-49785b13f2d7.png)

-	Dimension_Konto (indeholder alle felterne fra BYOD’ens ”Dimension_Konto” – altså alle kontoplanselementerne).
	- Fanen indeholder rimelig meget 1:1 dét, som vi også har i vores Dimension_Konto ved BYOD'en. Der mangler dog alle de ”Brugerdefineret1”, ”Brugerdefineret2” osv.
-	Dimension_hierarki  (indeholder begge hierarkier – både det Organisatoriske Hierarki (Dimension_DefaultHierarki) og den politiske organisation (Dimension_AfledtDimHierarki)
    - Hierarkierne er meget ”mangelfulde” i den forstand at de kun har felter til:
      - Organisatorisk Hierarki Lang 1-6
       - Politisk Organisation 1-3

Måden der skal kobles fra fanerne på er ved hjælp af naturlige "Afdelingskoder" fra hhv.
![image.png](/.attachments/image-e068229f-c7a2-494c-b806-29cd9f1b04c5.png)

![image.png](/.attachments/image-d8552830-bbc5-481e-874f-8bbc2e9c32ed.png)

Derudover skal vi bruge FinansKontoAlias, som vi pt lige skal have bekræftet, er kolonne B i FMKs ark.

# Forskelle fra BYOD til .CSV

1. **Indlæsning til TARGIT** 
Hvert fald afhængigt af, hvilken indlæsningsmetode, som vi går med fremadrettet.
2. **Forskellige joins grundet DW_SK_Nøgler kontra Naturlige nøgler**
Den nuværende extension kan ikke benyttes 1:1, da der i extensionen benyttes et view som erstatning til fact_Forbrug, som indeholder PRISME365s DW_SK_Konto - dette view bliver lavet i backenden. Derudover kobler vi på DW_SK_nøgler, som kommer fra backenden, og som ikke er en del af vores -csv.
3. **Struktur/Skabelon mangler til csv**
På nuværende tidspunkt har vi kun et udkast fra FMK, som mangler en del felter kontra det vi har i backenden. En skabelon til hvordan csv-filen skal se ud fremadrettet  med samme felter som i vores backend vil være gunstigt

path: /Teams/1. Administrative Domain Team/1.4 PRISME365/1.4.1 Prisme365 - Skive
content:
Beskedens formål er, at give lidt indblik PRISME365 implementeringen i Skive samt at få spredt viden til intern brug.

Vi er yderligere i PDT3 blevet enige om, at skrive lidt ”historik” ned, hvis det skulle blive aktuelt med PRISME365 i Skive igen på et senere tidspunkt. 

Efter vi fik implementeret PRISME365 i Skive, havde de store udfordringer med ”PRISME365 Autorisation”-modulet/universet. Basalt set, er det det modul, som styrer hvad de enkelte brugere har adgang til at se i deres SAP BO universer.
 
Autorisationsmodulet bliver delvist styret af kunderne selv i den forstand, at ved at Skive giver de enkelte medarbejdere adgang til diverse ”Afdelinger” inde i deres PRISME365 fagsystem, også får adgang til at se de selv samme data tilhørende disse afdelinger inde i PRISME365 universerne. 

Vi hiver diverse medarbejderes ”Brugernavn” og ”Afdeling” ind i vores backend-kode og kobler det op på det organisatoriske hierarki. Dette skal bare virke ”straight out of the box” – og virker også fx i Haderslev og Aabenraa, som vi senest har implementeret her i denne uge (uge 10).
 
Udfordringen kommer i, at Skive har en række brugere, som skal have fuld adgang til universet, da de skal have mulighed for at bogføre på tværs. Fremadrettet kalder jeg dem blot for ”superbrugere” – dette er der som sådan heller ikke noget specielt i, men det er måden som Skive har bygget deres organisatoriske hierarki op på, som giver udfordringen.
 
Det tekniske aspekt er, at superbrugerne som skal have fuld adgang har i Skives fagsystem tilkoblet sig en værdi fra feltet i fagsystemet som hedder ”Virksomhedsenhed”. Hertil er ideen, at hvis brugeren har en værdi i ”Virksomhedsenhed”, så skal de have fuld adgang til universerne. 
Hvis brugeren IKKE har en værdi i ”Virksomhedsenhed”, så skal modulet blot benytte ”Afdelingen” som normalt.
 
Dette understøtter vores ”PRISME365 Autorisations”-modul desværre ikke, og ovenstående med ”Virksomhedsenhed” er specifikt for Skive kommune. 
 
Løsningsforslagene var/er derfor som følger:
1.	”Lappeløsningen”
- [ ] Vi kan lave en lappeløsning, hvor vi manuelt tilføjer en tabel, som indeholder alle superbrugere. Så laver vi det således, at alle brugere i denne tabel får fuld adgang til universerne. Det bliver en håndholdt, og ikke så pæn løsning, men det er det hurtige quick fix. Dette kræver, at Skive leverer en excel fil med alle superbrugerne.
2.	Videreudvikling på autorisationsmodulet
- [ ] Vi kan i samarbejde med Fujitsu finde en løsning på at få ”Virksomhedsenhed” flettet ind i vores autorisationsmodul. Vi vil hertil flette kommunespecifik kode ind i vores modul, så det kun er i Skive, at den tager højde for denne virksomhedsenhed. (Kommunespecifik kode i sig selv er ikke så uhørt, det har vi allerede på bl.a. Aabenraa og Varde i modulet allerede).
3.	Lad være med at bruge ”Prisme365 Autorisation”-modulet
- [ ] Ved at vi ikke bruger autorisationsmodulet, så har alle brugere som udgangspunkt fuld adgang til alt i universet. Så skal de selv styre adgangen til diverse brugere på universerne, og det formoder jeg er noget SAP BO opsætning. Som TARGIT mand er jeg dog meget på udebane her, og det ved jeg reelt set ikke, hvordan det styres. Men det skulle kunne lade sig gøre, og vil selvfølgelig godt undersøge nærmere, hvis dette skulle blive aktuelt.
4.	Andre
- [ ] Der er sikkert også andre muligheder, hvis vi dykker dybere, men for nu lægger vi sagen her på hylden – og så har vi lidt på det, hvis det skulle blive aktuelt igen 😊
Dette er mine tanker og erfaringer – brug det som I vil, og ellers har vi altid lidt på skrift ift. de udfordringer, som det har bragt.
Documentation towards our customers are loaded to the customers sftp directory every day. The current version can be found at im-p (\\pfofil-as-im-p.sapsys.kmd.dk\im-p\CustomData-import\Guide)

**User request**
The customer need a user and directory at intftp.kmd.dk. The process starts by asking for the setup in a mail to Leszek (LEW).

"Hi Leszek,

We need a new user and related folder on intftp.kmd.dk. Settings below:


Username: randerscust
Directory: D:\userdata\customers\DIMA\Randers\CustomData

Limit disk space: off

General permissions:
-	List
-	Download
-	Upload

Subfolder permissions
-	Create
-	Rename
-	Delete



Reference. The user should have the same settings as other similar DIMA customer users, e.g., “randerscust”. 

Thanks! 
"

**Setting up the structure on intftp.kmd.dk**
The customer need the three folders "archived", "failed" and "guide" on the sftp directory. It can be copied from im-p (\\pfofil-as-im-p.sapsys.kmd.dk\im-p\CustomData-import\Structure). 

![image.png](/.attachments/image-20a50b15-c6d8-4f0c-8af5-307e759e946b.png)

**Setting up the SQL Server Job**
The job (001_BI_CUSTOMDATA_ETL) for running the solution need input on structure and user/pw for the specific customer. 

![image.png](/.attachments/image-c6d8b717-99e9-42c0-b9f7-5f00854679e9.png)

In step 1,2 and 6 username, password and path to main diretory is added (remember to postfix with "/").

![image.png](/.attachments/image-976c237f-54ae-4d61-bf12-17b1f67d3848.png)

This page documents different SQL-server related setup relevant for operations.

# Log drives

Log drives are filled with log files which expand and do not shrink again. 
As a consequence most log files are most of the time much larger than needed.

To avoid wasting space by having unnecessarily large drives we have set up a job that runs every half hour that automatically shrink the log files if the log drive has less than 15 % available space. It will shrink logfiles based on the size of the logfiles.
The logic is:

```
Every half hour
   
check if we are below 15 % 
   if no --> Exit 
   if yes 
      get a list of databases 
       REP for each database :  if the database logfile size is larger that 50 GB: shrink the logfile to 50 GB 
           are we below 15 % 
            if yes --> Exit
            if no  --> goto REP.
```

       

 This job has been set up and is managed by KMD:

Furthermore, every half hour a job is run that checks if we are below 10 % available space. This will only happen if the shrinking is insufficient to clear the needed space. In that case we (CDO, TNH, BFL, AYH, KMK) will get a mail informing that disk space on the log drive is insufficient. That will usually mean we need to increase disk space on the log drive.

path: /Technology & Software/1. SAPBO/1.3 IDT (Information Design Tool)/1.3.7 Best Practice/List of Values
content:
Due to performance constraints, we have a limit of 50,000 objects in a list of values. If your dimension contains many objects or exceeds this limit, it’s recommended to modify the default list of values. This allows customers to continue searching for specific values.

Follow these steps in the Information Design Tool to make the change:

1. Navigate to the dimension where you want to modify the list of values.
2. Switch to the "Advanced" tab.
3. In the "List of Values" section, enable "Force users to filter values before use" and "Allow users to search in values".
![image.png](/.attachments/image-e8756fb7-0bfa-445c-bfe8-cfa2dd10181f.png)

After these steps, users will experience a change when they try to use a list of values. Instead of being presented with a list, they’ll see instructions on how to search within the values. When they perform a search, they’ll see all values that match their search criteria. This optimizes performance and enhances user experience.

This feature should only be implemented on dimensions with many values.

path: /Teams/3. PDT5/3.2 IDT - change of data source
content:
Adjusting name of source on example of transforming STARGRUPPER to STAR in the backend. At the beginning our datamodel looks like this:

![IDT_wiki_before.png](/.attachments/IDT_wiki_before-5389df2a-83c3-40b4-a658-0b377e2ad07d.png)

When the data source changes, the best way to resolve this issue is to use the '**edit**' option in the Data Foundation layer by right clicking on the entity you want to adjust (NOTICE: it's not possible to change couple of entities at the same time by using this option). 

![IDT_Wiki_DF_opcje.png](/.attachments/IDT_Wiki_DF_opcje-211b74a8-1bd9-4012-a817-2f2c0b4dfe94.png)

After right clicking on the entity and choosing 'Edit' you're simply replacing the name of the solution (e.g. from STARGRUPPER to STAR, as in the example below) and all functionalities of datamodel are kept.

![IDT_wiki_DF_edit.png](/.attachments/IDT_wiki_DF_edit-8cfb940a-2dd4-49bc-bb8c-d94830f51a41.png)

After providing desired new name (e.g. STAR_03DM_Dim_UnemploymentFund) you need to only confirm by clicking 'Yes' to the message which will show up:

![IDT_wiki_DF_edit_02.png](/.attachments/IDT_wiki_DF_edit_02-740ff336-30dc-4906-8f25-c21287ae2f18.png)

Final result after making changes:

![image.png](/.attachments/image-efab567f-c418-48fe-ba9f-e9f1320e8a9c.png)


-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
**NOTICE:**
It is _not recommended_ to use the '**replace by**' option for this type of modification. 
It causes a lot of inconvenience, which is then difficult to adjust properly to get the final properly created datamodel and business layer. Problems that occur in that process are for instance:
- empty tabs other than 'Master' tab when you're working with 'aggregate awareness' universe - you have to manually add all entities to all the other tabs (e.g. Dag, Maned, All). It might be done by dragging the appropriate tables from the data foundation onto individual tabs or by using the option 'Add to View...' when have selected proper entities in Data Foundation 'Master' tab,
- context remains (option of what should be taken into consideration, when selecting proper context), but aggregate navigation disappears,
- from business layer perspective all dimensions and measures, whose source has changed become worthless (see below)

![IDT_wiki_01.png](/.attachments/IDT_wiki_01-237c5008-2c66-44b7-ab78-6e49aaac6f66.png)

Also in the case of aggregate awareness universes, it is not reasonable to use the option to replace existing entities **manually** since this is a _very tedious and time-consuming task_.

path: /Technology & Software/2. Targit/2.6 Development/2.6.2 Best Practice When Working With Changes and Additions to Cimensions and Measures
content:
There is a few guidelines that one should adhere to, when working with changes and additions to dimensions and measures.

First of all, don't just delete or rename dimensions or measures, because if they have been used in analyses and reports, these will break. Instead, move them to an "Arkiv" (archive) folder for a grace period, so the customer have time to phase out the use of old dimensions and measures and switch to new ones.

![image.png](/.attachments/image-b42cb5dc-d327-4805-aa16-771cdec1d9cb.png)

So if you have dimensions or measures that you wish to delete or rename (fx. they are no longer valid or just need to be phased out) make arrangements with the customers that old dimensions or measures will be available in the archive folder for two release cycles and then they will be removed from the solution. This will give them some time to change their analyses and reports, but not forever.

The above procedure can also be used if you need to change the formatting of a dimension or the calculation of a measure; keep the before and after version of the dimension or measure for a period and give the customer time to change their analyses and reports.

path: /Technology & Software/2. Targit/2.12 Tips and Tricks/2.12.2 Possible Customer Adjustments to Solutions
content:
The customers have the possibility to make adjustments to their TARGIT solutions in several ways:

**Rename dimensions and measures**
If the customer wants to change the naming of dimensions or measures, this can be done in the Language section of TARGIT Management:

![image.png](/.attachments/image-e578d8cf-d6eb-4c7e-a834-ed3f3b9f167f.png)

This TARGIT Community article describes how to do it:

https://community.targit.com/hc/en-us/articles/360016940217-Language-translations-of-metadata-folders-and-documents


**Hide dimensions and measures in roles**
If the customer want to prohibit users from using certain dimensions or measures, this can be configured through roles setup:

![image.png](/.attachments/image-af72beda-76b0-4a44-990b-ff613aac6f25.png)

Simply deselect the checkmark beside the relevant dimension or measures, so the status of the "Tilladelse" (permission) column says "Ingen i denne rolle" (none in this role).


**User dimensions**
A User dimension is a dimension that is created by the end-user. The individual dimension members of a User dimension are defined from criteria from one or more standard dimensions.

This TARGIT Community guide shows how use User dimensions:

https://community.targit.com/hc/en-us/articles/360017720917-Basic-User-Dimensions





**Global / Mash-up dimensions**
A Mashup dimension is a mapping of dimensions with identical dimensions members across different cubes and across different data connections. 

The purpose of a Mashup dimension is to create a single point of applying criteria that will work across data from different cubes and different connections. This way customers have the possible to combine solutions and data sources and fx. look up a citizen in several solutions simultaneously.

Mashup dimensions will in many cases work in the same manner as the previous feature called 'Global dimensions'. However, Mashup dimensions comes with an interface in the TARGIT client to facilitate the process of creating a Mashup dimension.

This TARGIT Community article describes how to do it:

https://community.targit.com/hc/en-us/articles/11194815048732-Mashup-Dimensions

path: /Technology & Software/7. Admin Portal/7.5 Management Portal/7.5.1 Using Portal API for Access Request
content:
[[_TOC_]]

# How to get access to DB modules using API
This wiki page gives in introduction to the module kmdbips.portalapi.001 and how this module can be utilized for gaining access to database modules in either production or development environments.

## Description

That application is made for easy maintaining our accesses in portal. You can configure accesses that You want to use and with a one click add many of them. You can save Your accesses list and reuse it on a next time. You can delete accesses that You do not need. You can add accesses for databases and/or areas. 

### Prerequisite/requirements
That application is adding accesses in the new portals dev and prod(kdipmssdbxx and kdidmssdb servers):

https://devadminportal.intranet.kmdhub.net/
https://prodadminportal.intranet.kmdhub.net/

## 1. Clone application repository. It need to be done once


```
$portalAppPath = "E:\KMDWORK\z6xxx\"

cd $portalAppPath

git clone https://dev.azure.com/kmd-dima/KMD.DIMA.LG/_git/kmdbips.portalapi.001
```

## 2. Start application with batch file
"E:\KMDWORK\z6xxx\kmdbips.portalapi.001\app\run_PortalApp.bat"

Running this application gives an interface for creating/manipulating the configuration files with all input for which database you need access to. You can also go ahead configuring the access directly in:
- area.csv (contains info on the area you want access to, gives access to log, common, dsa and dataarea on a given area for a given customer.)
- database.csv (contains information if you request access for a specific database on a specific server)
- user.txt (contains information about as which user you are requesting access for - will be yourself)

If you configure it directly, then step 2 and three can be skipped.

## 3. Setup application parameters

Fill user name with Your portal email and save it. ex.: xxx@kmd.dk, xxx@kmdpoland.pl (saves config to user.txt).
You can check this in portal under user\user tab.

Add accesses for area or/and database. For each You need to save a list with specific buttons 'save area' (saves config to area.csv), 'save database' (saves config to database.csv).

You can add many different accesses, delete accesses which you do not need, store it and reuse it on a next run. 

Parameter Description:

	Environment: PROD/DEV 		-required
	Area: area name 			-required
	Customer: customer number	-required
	Server:	sql server name		-required	
	Database: database name		-required
	ifIqAccess: 0/1				-required
	durationInHours: hour number, ex.: 168, 48, 24	-required
	ifRoleWriter: 0/1			-required
	ifRoleDDLAdmin: 0/1			-required
	reason: reasone code table below, use reasonCode value. You need to use correspondings reasons with environment which You choosed on a previous field.	-required
	casenumber: case number		-check reason code table if it is required
	smartExpire: 0/1			-required
	
	
	ReasonCode	ReasonDescription		Default	        CaseNumberRequired
	DEV001		Development			0		0
	DEV002		Test				1		0
	DEV003		Support – Service Case		0		1
	DEV004		Support - Interne maintanance	0		0
	DEV005		Implementation			0		0
	DEV006		Development of rapport		0		0
	DEV007		Other				0		1
	DEV008		Customer demonstration		0		0
	DEV009		Test new release		0		0
	DEV010		Customer inquiry		0		1
	PROD001		Support - Service Case		1		1
	PROD002		Support - Interne maintanance	0		0
	PROD003		Implementation			0		0
	PROD004		Development of rapport		0		0
	PROD005		Other				0		1
	PROD006		Customer demonstration		0		0
	PROD007		Test new release		0		0
	PROD008		Customer inquiry		0		1
	

![image.png](/.attachments/image-38916d69-1ea2-4133-8407-fa7908b32547.png)

## 4. Run application

IMPORTANT: before You run 'AddPersmissons', You need to be authorized in portal prod and dev through browser. That action needs to be done once a day. Probably it will not be necessary after new portal version will be released.

https://prodadminportal.intranet.kmdhub.net/
https://devadminportal.intranet.kmdhub.net/

If parameters are setup and You are authorized in portal, You can run 'AddPersmissions' button.

If specific access exists it will be skipped and You will get the information.

You will see the log output in a texbox at the bottom. 
![image.png](/.attachments/image-ec3b01ba-d23c-4d3b-a965-11c5e09cd231.png)

### Command line AddPermission
If you have configured user.txt, area.csv or database.csv, then you can skip the 'AddPermission' button in the interface by running the 'AddPermissions' function in  ../app/portal_apps.ps1 script. Here is an example on how that is done:

```
# set directory to root folder of kmdbips.portalapi.001
cd <root folder of cloned module> 

# Run command to execute AddPermission function
.\app\Portal_app.ps1 -cmdexec $true

# By setting the input parameter -cmdexec to true, then the AddPermission function will be executed based on the configurations you have in database.csv, area.csv and user.txt.
```

## Known errors

- Errors output gui box

Most of the errors You will see in the output gui textbox.

known errors:

 "Similar entry already exists. First delete or force it to expire before creating a new." 
- that means that the access exists in portal but it have wrong status "Access:Error". You could try to force it to expire directly in portal and add it again. If that will not solve the problem, that means that probably some configuration is broken in portal. You could try to check and fix that, and if it still do not work You need to contact with portal developers.

Errors in console:
Less often errors could show up in a console. They could appear because You did not log to portal prod or/and dev through browser. If that is not a case please contact with me: mpc@kmd.dk

content:
Due to GDPR and quality assurance of our work, it has been decided that we can no longer use our automatic tool to transport standard reports into production.

Therefore, we need a process for how this is handled.

The most essential aspect concerning the transportation of reports is that reports containing sensitive personal information are not saved.

The transportation of reports is handled by the support team (IBR and JA) or the SAP BO team (FSH, AYH, and BFL). With this shared responsibility, we ensure availability during regular working hours.

Changes can be made in two ways. Find the method used to determine the correct workflow.

**1) Standard reports made in development:**
If report changes are made in development and need to be transported to production, follow the below method. 

Report changes are completed in development ([https://kmd-insight-development.kmd.dk/BOE/BI]) and saved in the standard report folder on development.

![image.png](/.attachments/image-3f31ec60-80c8-41e7-861b-acf555e2f2c3.png)

In this case, the process is to first open the report in BI Launchpad to clear the data in the report. This is done by purging the report and then saving it.

When the report no longer contains data, log in to the 360 tool 
([http://kdip360ap00.kmdpfosap.local:5920/360.suite/login]) in both development (kdidzd3ap00.kmdpfosap.local) and production (kdipzp3ap00.kmdpfosap.local)

and place the report in the shopping cart by right clicking on it and, clicking on "Selection card" and "Add to selection cart". Afterwards, promote the report using the settings specified in the screenshots below.

Finding and opening the report folder:

![image.png](/.attachments/image-22a1039f-cb32-4b23-aa53-7991f8121bfc.png)


Check that the promotion job was successful: 

![image.png](/.attachments/image-a02a78bd-aa91-48bb-afad-28b3c6d5f4c0.png)

![image.png](/.attachments/image-e673bbbd-b336-474c-b28a-4b8be1f917ea.png)


If the job is successful, the report changes are completed in production [(https://kmd-insight.kmd.dk/BOE/BI)] . Make sure to have the person who requested the transportation check that the changes a properly transferred. 

**2. Standard reports made/ changed in production (But in a different folder e.g. KMD BI-Center Intern):**

Here, the report should be opened in SAP BO launchpad at the location where the change was made. The report should again be cleared of data and then saved.

![image.png](/.attachments/image-47ed1b9b-fbaa-4f9c-b0ab-8dc98c116190.png)

![image.png](/.attachments/image-5e81b833-0f84-43fa-9e8e-5233aaf54127.png)

**If the report already exists in the standard report folder, but has been edited in another folder:**
Once the data has been purged from the report, select "Save As" and overwrite the existing report in the KMD standard report folder. 

It is important to use this method (as opposed to for instance cut and paste) to retain the report's CUID, which ensures that any links to the report still function as before.

![image.png](/.attachments/image-b921a17a-dbf3-44d2-821b-434edf05b167.png)


**If it is a new report:**
If the report is new (No report with the same name exists in the standard report folder), the report should be moved by cut and paste. Purge the report for data and save it. Go to the folder where the report was edited, click "Organize" and "Cut". Go to the standard report folder and click on the three dots in the right corner. Select "Paste". 


It is always important, after a transportation is completed, to have the person who requested the transportation check that everything appears as desired.

**If the promotion from dev to production doesn't work** (Talk with Brian or Anna)
Check if there is a mismatch between folder CUIDs. To promote you need the exact same folder ids in the path down to the report. If the IDs do not match we need to move content to another folder, delete the folder that doesn't match on production and properly promote the folder from dev to production. Lastly, move the content back into the folder.

path: /Technology & Software/1. SAPBO/1.2 IQ/1.2.1 Access to IQ
content:
# Access to IQ using IDE software
For accessing and querying the IQ server you can go use any of the suggested DB management tools listed below:
- DBeaver
- AQT

DBeaver is installed on KDIDRDPAP01 or KDIDRDPAP02 and can be utilized for everyone having access to this remote server. AQT can be installed on you local laptop if needed. Contact TNH if you need assistance on setting up AQT on you local environment.

## Access to IQ using DBeaver
This guideline adresses how to access IQ environment using DBeaver.
1. Login into KDIDRDPAP01 or KDIDRDPAP02 using RDP access.
2. Open DBeaver from exe file on path: C:\Program Files\DBeaver\dbeaver.exe
3. Choose 'Sybase JConnect' as connection - hit next.
4. Pass IP address for the IQ server you want to access. Get overview of all servers here: https://dev.azure.com/kmd-dima/KMD.DIMA.LG/_wiki/wikis/KMD.DIMA.LG.wiki/8835/1.2-On-Premise. Remember to use Port 6000. The credentials you provide is the typically you own, where you have requested access to a given object using the Admin Access Portal. Note that the password is not linked to you KMD account, so it is not changed with the frequency of that domain. If you have forgotten the password, please contact TNH and he can reset your account. Then hit 'Finish'.
5. You now see the connection in the left side menu. Please collapse this connection. It then prompt you to download some missing files. Please go ahead download both files.
6. Change Charset property for connection. Right click on the established connection -> click 'Edit Connection' -> hit 'Driver properties' in the centralized sheet menu -> Scroll down and find 'CHARSET' property and change the value to 'uft8' -> click OK.
![image.png](/.attachments/image-ce0ff4c0-2b04-490a-af88-be2614201304.png)
7. Make sure you have requested access to a given role through the Admin portal, and now you will be able to browse that particular database schema.

Dette dokument har til formål at beskrive, hvordan Single sign-on fungerer til KMD Insight. KMD Insight benytter SAML (Security Assertion Markup Language) til at foretage Single sign-on til KMD Insight. For at benytte SAML til single sign-on kræver det, at det er oprettet et trust, hvilket sker gennem KMD Identity (Se vedhæftede dokumentation for KMD Identity). 

**1. Oprettelse af trust** 
Se punkt 2, hvis trust allerede er oprettet

Flowet er som følgende:
![image.png](/.attachments/image-d9ae78a3-36a2-400e-993a-b23fd9e7b0ca.png)

Når I har oprettet et trust til KMD Identity vil I benytte ovenstående flow, hvor jeres Windows AD vil legitimere jer ind i KMD Insight. Dette gøres via email adressen, hvor SAML validerer emailen op i mod den angivne email for brugeren i KMD Insight, samt hvilken kommune jeres AD kommer fra. Det betyder også at en email adressen skal være unik i KMD Insight. Det vil sige at flere brugere ikke kan benytte den samme email. 

Det er derfor essentielt at den email adresse, der forekommer inde i Kmd Insight modsvarer den email i anvender i jeres Windows AD. 

**Test**
I kan teste den information, I sender via KMD Identity via nedenstående link:
https://test.identity.kmd.dk/

På siden vælger I SAML (Web) Log-in

![image.png](/.attachments/image-2fe4a2c9-3c92-4e58-a090-3dc79e728c86.png)

Herefter vælger i kommunens AD, vær opmærksom på, at I først er tilgængelig på listen, når der er oprettet et trust til KMD Identity og vælg muligheden med ”Husk mit valg (remember my choise)”. På den måde behøver I ikke vælge kommune igen ved næste login. Herefter klikkes ”Log-in”. 

![image.png](/.attachments/image-57ab0860-4d3e-4a7a-9523-f0418845da1a.png)

I vil få en liste over de informationer, der kommer via jeres trust til KMD Identity. 
Tilgå dette link, for at se hvilken information, der anvendes i KMD Insight: 

http://schemas.xmlsoap.org/ws/2005/05/identity/claims/nameidentifier

Tjek informationen named identifier (øverst linket). Den skal indeholde den samme email, der er indberettet til KMD Insight for et logon bliver gennemført korrekt.  

Når I har oprettet et trust til KMD Identity melder i tilbage til supporten i KMD Insight at trusted er på plads, hvorefter SAML gøres tilgængelig for KMD Insight. I får besked herom, når det er på plads. 

Når I får denne besked, bør I kunne anvende Single Sign-on til KMD Insight. 

**2. Anvend Single Sign til KMD Insight** 
_(Når trust er oprettet og SAML gjort tilgængelig)_:

Tilgå KMD Insight via SSO ved at bruge nedenstående link. Vær opmærksom på at lukke alle browservinduer inden du forsøger at anvende linket. 

https://insight.kmd.dk/BO/BI

Vælg den kommune, du kommer fra og ”Husk mig valg” og Log-in (Det er kun nødvendigt første gang, hvorefter brugeren automatisk vil blive logget ind på relevante kommune).

![image.png](/.attachments/image-9224140c-0348-4e63-9ef6-0e796c3b7b8c.png)

Brugeren er logget ind, såfremt validering er gennemført korrekt 

![image.png](/.attachments/image-cc8b4460-0644-49bc-8ac2-57e3ee53a4b2.png)

En vigtig info er at implementeringen af løsningen hos slutbrugerne kræver, at de logger ind via det nye link (https://insight.kmd.dk/BO/BI) eller at I opretter nogle links via guiden SAML links til KMD Insight. Guiden findes i KMD Insight under Public Folders/Undervisning og Vejledninger.

path: /Technology & Software/1. SAPBO/1.4 Other/1.4.3 How to kill blocking transactions on SAP BO for the new SQL Server
content:
How to kill blocking transactions on SAP BO for the new SQL Server 
 
Logon remote to kditzt3db.kmdpfosap.local aka test DB ZT3 server

![clip_image002.png](/.attachments/clip_image002-ac09077b-bb56-4cc8-9053-23917ec98d06.png)

IP adress 172.31.54.145
Open SQL Server management studio

![clip_image004.png](/.attachments/clip_image004-6ebafc77-2c24-4def-884f-87bc51173ad5.png)

 
Connect to production with kdipzp3db and SQL Server authentication
Login with the user Support and the password in secret server (see: SAP BO User to kill logs)
 
![clip_image006.png](/.attachments/clip_image006-d1f9e4b8-1f9c-46e4-bd86-e55a3cb3daf6.png)


Hit the “new query” 
_who2  
![clip_image008.png](/.attachments/clip_image008-b20c865f-61b9-41b8-8faa-5cf311436c0c.png)

Be sure the database it BOBJ_REP
![clip_image010.png](/.attachments/clip_image010-23c61a20-7292-4ddd-aeee-3cc360fb5024.png)


In a new sql query window run:
Sp_WHO2!
![clip_image012.png](/.attachments/clip_image012-d8d373b4-efa4-4898-9fb4-cf8439a47a30.png)


It will give you a list of all transactions on the server:
 
![clip_image014.png](/.attachments/clip_image014-f26a5dc3-1243-4740-9346-0af6580b269d.png)


 
Check the column BlkBy, if no number is shown everything is OK.
If there is a number then the number in the BlkBy column is the process (SPID column)  blocking the transaction.
 
So if BlkBy Says 56 then look in the column SPID for 56 
Note they can be nested, så 68 is blocked by 56 the has a BlkBy spid of 73 it is 73 that is the important one. 
Normally there is an update, an insert or a delete involved in the blocking. 
 
Then you can use 
 
DBCC INPUTBUFFER(56) — to give you the Event Info.(what is it running)
And if you need to kill it then use this one:
 
KILL 56 -- Will kill the session of this id.
 
You can also get an overview by using the report, but that is not as easy read as SP_WHO2

# Summary
The deployment tool is a PowerShell script that makes the process of releasing updates for solutions to customers easier.

# Prerequisites
The deployment tool will only function on the development server (KMDAPP0138 - 172.31.112.36)
You need to have had PDT3 set up Automatic Deployment on the customer servers.

## Management studio
You need to have a connection running that contains the solution that you want to deploy to a customer.

If the datamodel is customer specific - you will need a separate connection.

![image.png](/.attachments/image-7552e1ca-16ca-4f64-ae5c-9067dd38a465.png)

![image.png](/.attachments/image-cb354105-4d37-4ff5-8ecc-5539feeea2f6.png)
*657_AS2007 connection contains the 657_AS2007 database the prefix "657_" will be removed on deployment so it is fine to name the databases like this.*

So just create a new connection. Add the database and then import the datamodel you want.

## TargitSources
You need to make sure that the impd  @Solution/@dsSOLUTION @Environment/@dsENVIRONMENT exists on the customer server.
![image.png](/.attachments/image-b019019b-7e65-4112-aa2c-ac17bd82ba95.png)
Customer number prefixes are removed automatically and "DEV" is changed to "PROD" by the script.

You can check if it exists on our Operations platform.
[TargitSources ](https://targit.intranet.kmdhub.net/touchserver/#vfs://global/Portal/OPERATIONS/CUSTOMER%20TARGIT%20SOURCES.xview)
![image.png](/.attachments/image-364985a2-8a2d-4c71-918e-0bbc1d66b472.png)

Here is the match for the AS2007 solution:
![image.png](/.attachments/image-5d5fcdf4-256d-4b32-8503-3eb24c853fb0.png)

If it doesn't match - the either it needs to be added to the customers TargitSources file or changed in the ETL package.
## ETL
The ETL package that you want to deploy must be located in the Targit Schedules.
![image.png](/.attachments/image-ea8bf708-ac7c-454b-80fb-67b71a9fc676.png)

If it is not there. You need to deploy it on the server from the ETL project. The folder doesn't matter and is only for your own benefit.

# Running the script
The script is located on the desktop on KMDAPP0138 - 172.31.112.36. 
To run it. Right click it and select "Run with PowerShell"
![image.png](/.attachments/image-f86f829a-606a-4069-88c6-76d9f9fe4c0d.png)

You will then be asked to select the solution that you wish to deploy.
![image.png](/.attachments/image-5c765910-5465-4935-9bea-5fc982e05742.png)

You can sort the columns or use Filter to find the solution.
(The customer prefix has already been removed from the InMemory Database here.)

If your solution is not here please check the prerequisites section.

After selecting the solution you will be asked if you want to deploy the ETL, Datamodel or Both:
![image.png](/.attachments/image-1f7a9025-9e7b-4382-8da2-e6dd9fddae84.png)

If you have only made changes to one part of the solution then select that. Otherwise pick both (default when pressing enter)
Then the customers that you can deploy the solution to will appear and you can select one or multiple of these.
![image.png](/.attachments/image-f62ba489-1f0b-4c47-9fc3-58fe3fca5a54.png)
If the customer you want to deploy to is not here. Then you need to contact PDT3 to set it up.

Finally you will need to select the ETL package that you want to deploy (If more than 1 is found on the server).
![image.png](/.attachments/image-14bc2b21-5b07-49f7-a32c-135ad951ca81.png)

Pay special attention to the "Folder" it will be the same as the folder in the Scheduler service.

Finally the solution will be deployed. It can take some time to deploy the "Datamodel"

![image.png](/.attachments/image-456330f9-76d0-4ab1-ae17-f91140888c6c.png)
*Solutions will get skipped if they are the same as the ones already deployed. (Modified date for datamodel and build number for ETL)*

The solution is now ready to be pulled from the customer server. The ETL will be pulled within 5 minutes but the datamodel will not get pulled before the ETL package has been run.

# Getting a customer ready for Auto Deployment
##Prerequisites
The solution needs to have been set up on our own side: [KMD Setup](https://dev.azure.com/kmd-dima/KMD.DIMA.LG/_wiki/wikis/KMD.DIMA.LG.wiki/5665/Configuration-on-KMD-site-%E2%80%93-PDT3)
Meaning that it has an entries in the [kmdbi].[TargitDeployDistribution] table. One for the impd file and one for each connection.

### Targit InMemory Scheduler Management
A folder in Targit InMemory Scheduler Management called "KMDProduction"
![image.png](/.attachments/image-cd591a1d-540a-44e9-ad91-6cbb7354d497.png)


##Powershell scripts
The customer needs the following files on D:\KMD\Config\PowerShell or equivalent:
GetSolutions.ps1
ExecuteIMPD.ps1

Found here: [Scripts](https://dev.azure.com/kmd-dima/KMD.DIMA.LG/_git/targit.tool.global?path=/tools/StatusReporting)

and a variables file:
script.cfg
```
customer=746
VFSFolder=\\Skbapp2001\vfs\
SettingsFolder=\\SKBAPP2001\Settings\
PublishedFolders=D:\KMD\Targit\Schedules\PublishedFolders\
TargitSchServiceFolder=C:\Program Files\TARGIT\TARGIT InMemory Scheduler Service\
InMemoryDBFolder=C:\Program Files\TARGIT\TARGIT InMemoryDB\
SolutionsFolder=D:\KMD\Install\Solutions\
targetserver=195.50.52.42
DataFolder=D:\KMD\Targit\Databases\Data
NotReportingSolutions=KMDConfigurations,KMDStatusReporting,ConditionalStart_*
targitsources=D:\KMD\Config\Targit\TargitSources.csv
```
The neccesary fields for autodeployment are
* Customer 
* SettingsFolder 
* PublishedFolders
* TargitSchServiceFolder
* SolutionsFolder
* Targetserver
* Datafolder

## Task Scheduler
You need 1 task in the Windows Task Scheduler
1. ScriptOrchestrator

![image.png](/.attachments/image-848eecd5-bcc5-40ee-a92c-806d00c4a951.png)
The task should be run by the service user:
![image.png](/.attachments/image-b4af8268-2bb0-4878-a7dc-a1c5cb677042.png)

ScriptOrchestrator needs to run "GetSolutions.ps1" every 5 minutes.
![image.png](/.attachments/image-c027dca1-2680-4626-902b-31d874730cf1.png)
![image.png](/.attachments/image-afd5a6ed-760d-4338-95dd-aee8c7279224.png)

Script Orchestrator will start any other script that needs to be run.


## Conditional Start (Mostly deprecated - delete schedule)
Run the "GetSolutions" in the Task Scheduler or wait for it to run itself.

In Targit InMemory Scheduler Management the ETL package should appear:
![image.png](/.attachments/image-d069024e-ac6d-419c-a55d-13a20010c881.png)

Now open the existing Conditional Start for the package. (Should be located in D:\KMD\Install\Solutions\KMD\ConditionalStart or D:\KMD\Install\Solutions\KMD)
![image.png](/.attachments/image-c01279e5-0026-4cce-86b6-db54be8da1e8.png)

Change the following 2 things:
1. Set deployment folder to KMDProduction:
![image.png](/.attachments/image-d207aaa6-852e-456a-91f1-5bb57b065d30.png)

2. Change the Run IMPD file to the new file:
![image.png](/.attachments/image-3d285494-01fc-48da-beb1-054c971e3120.png)

Save the file and deploy it.

After the new ETL package is run the datamodel will be deployed.
You can either run it manually or change the 
[kmdbi].[TargitDeployDistribution] table such that "RunIMPD" is 1 for the solution.
Or simply wait for the ETL to be executed by the Conditional Start.

##Cleanup
Remove the old conditional start package in the Scheduler (Usually in the KMD folder)
Remove the old ETL package from scheduler (usually found in a folder of the same name)
Run the New ETL package once to generate a status file which is necessary for conditional start to work.
