path: /Technology & Software/2. Targit/2.7 Production/2.7.1 BI Operations Portal
content:
# BI Operations Portal


## Introduction
The BI Operations Portal contains overview and detailed information on daily operations; ETL jobs status on both backend and TARGIT customer servers, server information, customer contracts and much more.

The portal can be reached from this address: https://targit.intranet.kmdhub.net/

You will need a kmdpfosap user account to login, or a custom local user account on the server, and if you need the latter type, please contact Michael Overgaard (ocg@kmd.dk) or Claus Donner (cdo@kmd.dk), who are the administrators of the portal.

-------------------------

## TARGIT Anywhere address
Previously the BI Operations Portal utilized TARGIT Signed Login functionality, so users could log in anonymously without entering credentials, but newer versions of TARGIT do not support this anymore, and the anonymous access was also a problem concerning our logging requirements. So TARGIT was upgraded to the latest version (24.6.19002) and the following changes to setup was made:

We had the DNS setup, so that the add address https://targit.intranet.kmdhub.net/ would point the servers IP-address http://172.31.112.31.

## Authentication
In the IIS configuration, the "Authentication" for "Default Web Site" should be setup like this:

![image.png](/.attachments/image-71980be6-02c1-4413-8e4b-8ed657fc8c4b.png)

and the subfolder/site "Touchserver" (which contains the installation of TARGIT Anywhere) should be setup like this:

![image.png](/.attachments/image-bd1aed9e-f9f0-4fa4-99d7-e0132cde0ae4.png)

to ensure access to TARGIT Anywhere.

## Web.config configurations
### Redirect to TARGIT Anywhere
To reach TARGIT Anywhere from the above address, the IIS module UrlRewrite was installed and configured so the web.config in this location:

![image.png](/.attachments/image-63a3524e-d022-4d78-bc26-656e3f812785.png)

now contained this section:

'<configuration>
    <system.webServer>
        **<rewrite>
            <rules>
                <rule name="Redirect to touchserver" patternSyntax="ECMAScript" stopProcessing="true">
                    <match url="^$" />
                    <action type="Redirect" url="https://targit.intranet.kmdhub.net/touchserver/" />
                </rule>
            </rules>
        </rewrite>**
	</system.webServer>
</configuration>'

### Hide TARGIT Anywhere toolbar
The web.config in the subfolder "Touchserver" (where TARGIT Anywhere website is located):

![image.png](/.attachments/image-f9680aa7-b9c0-4db0-8061-2a37c2545c75.png)

was configured to contain this section:

'<configuration>
  <location path="." inheritInChildApplications="false">
    <system.webServer>
      <handlers>
        <remove name="aspNetCore" />
        <add name="aspNetCore" path="*" verb="*" modules="AspNetCoreModuleV2" resourceType="Unspecified" />
      </handlers>
      <aspNetCore processPath=".\AnywhereCore.exe" arguments="" stdoutLogEnabled="false" requestTimeout="00:30:00" hostingModel="outofprocess" stdoutLogFile=".\logs\stdout">
        <environmentVariables />
      </aspNetCore>
      <security>
        <requestFiltering>
          <requestLimits maxQueryString="32768" />
        </requestFiltering>
      </security>
		**<rewrite>
			<rules>
				<rule name="embedRedirect" stopProcessing="true">
					<match url="^$" />
					<conditions>
						<add input="{REQUEST_URI}" pattern="^/$" />
					</conditions>
					<action type="Redirect" url="/embed" />
				</rule>
			</rules>
		</rewrite>**
    </system.webServer>
  </location>
</configuration>'

so that the toolbar in TARGIT Anywhere is not shown. The toolbar offers several function working with TARGIT from a browser, but since you can't configure the toolbar in anyway, we will implement the functions the portal should offer directly into the portal pages instead, which is why we hide the toolbar. Be aware that when upgrading TARGIT this last web.config is overwritten, so the above changes needs to added once again.


## Encryption
Furthermore, to ensure encrypted communication with TARGIT, we added this certificate to the server:

![image.png](/.attachments/image-12abb55e-e425-46ae-aa87-6466f0331cc3.png)

and chose it as the active certificate in TARGIT Management:

![image.png](/.attachments/image-03aa3cde-5cd9-4ec6-b13a-cd8c1b585ac1.png)

In addition to this, we deleted the Signed Login on port 8080 from IIS configuration as well as normal, but unencrypted, access on port 80, so TARGIT Anywhere now only can be reached on port 443:

![image.png](/.attachments/image-645d3e05-f16e-4e96-b937-b83413b68257.png)

-------------------------

## TARGIT Rights and Roles
In order to provide only necessary access to data and functionality in TARGIT, we have configured the following rights and roles:

![image.png](/.attachments/image-e62e03e6-eb13-4f6c-99d0-45ab82039c93.png)

- "Advanced Users" is a legacy rights group, which are no longer used.
- "Consumer" is for users of TARGIT Anywhere only, which do not need to develop their own analyses.
- "Designer" is for users who will contribute with analyses to the BI Operations Portal.

![image.png](/.attachments/image-ce5fcc44-569d-4595-820b-4283eaed9917.png)

By default all users are members of "_No Access (Data)", which denies access to all data in TARGIT, so no one will have unintended access to specific data. The other roles postfixed with "(Data)" will then provide access to necessary data.

- "_Full access (Data)" will have access to all data sources in TARGIT. Developers and Contributors to the portal will most likely have this role.
- "_Portal Access (Data)" will only have read access to the data used in the portal.
- "_Portal Contributors (Docs)" will have read access to the analyses used in the portal. The "Portal" and "Test" folders will have   equivalent folder structures (eg. Production and Test environments), and Contributors will have write access to the "Test" folder structure:

![image.png](/.attachments/image-7fde3bd4-1d1b-49de-86ae-03fcafe910aa.png)

When potential new analyses, which should be implemented in the portal, have been tested and are ready, portal administrators will copy the analyses to the equivalent place in the "Portal" folder structure.
- "_Portal Users (Docs)" will only have read access to analyses used in the portal.
- "_Targit Administrators" the administrators of the BI Operations Portal, which also maintains the setup and these rights and roles.

This is the initial rights and roles setup, to have a bit more control of what is made available in the BI Operations Portal than before, but if any suggestions arise on potential adjustments to the setup, in order to support daily operations better, please reach out to portal administrators.

-------------------------

## TARGIT Logging

Setting up logging functionality is described is this article:

https://dev.azure.com/kmd-dima/KMD.DIMA.LG/_wiki/wikis/KMD.DIMA.LG.wiki/3418/Setting-up-the-logging-functionality

All internal TARGIT servers are setup to log requests to the same database (TARGITLOG) on KDIPMSSDB01 server.

content:
This guide describes how to order and upload a new certificate to klgateway test and production

Requirements
* MitID Erhverv
* Serviceportal permissions

Gå til Myportal -> IT support -> Other -> Certificates requests
https://servicenow.kmd.dk/myportal?id=catalog_homepage&sc_catalog=3775674a0dc3005021be06d8b910a48b&spa=1&sc_category=09b2366d0cec89509290ce7dceb835cd&sys_id=54c276b7bdbf0dd862dd55d13a19c6c6

![image.png](/.attachments/image-435e0f50-7499-4d6f-b2f5-cfe97a1fcaec.png)

Fill out the form
![image.png](/.attachments/image-49495922-a9b3-45ef-b010-26f7b0a706e0.png)

After approval of your manager you will receive an email.
Follow the link and download the certificate by providing the one time code your received in a sperate email.
You will receive a code, please add it to passwords.kmd.dk

![image.png](/.attachments/image-092e7ea8-67d0-4f1e-9227-33a64977e893.png)

Place the p12 file on the im-p fileshare.
`\\pfofil-as-im-p.sapsys.kmd.dk\im-p\NEXUS KL Gateway\Certificate\OCES3`

To generate the .pfx file (with password)
- import the certificate as described above but allow export with password. When exporting it the select pfx format.

To generate the .cer file from the .p12 file, please follow this guide
https://knowledge.broadcom.com/external/article/255929/how-to-extractexport-the-certificate-cer.html
- Remember that the export format should be "Base-64 encoded X.509 (.CER)"
- place the .cer file on the im-p fileshare

To generate the .pem file from the .p12
- certutil -encode NEXUS_KL_Gateway_Test.p12 NEXUS_KL_Gateway_Test.pem

Upload the certificate to serviceplatformen
https://www.serviceplatformen.dk/administration/
1. Login to "Administrationsmodulet (produktion)" or "Administrationsmodulet (ekstest)" 
2. Go to "It-systemer" and search for "KMD NEXUS KL GATEWAY", pick the entry 
3. Go to the tab Anvendersystem and drag the .cer file into the certificate upload window
4. Press save in the bottom of the window
4. We have experienced that it does not immediately take effect and it works the day after

Upload the certificate to trifork
* Make a pull request with the .cer file on this github page https://github.com/trifork/klg-docs/pulls
1. Fork the project
2. Make the change in your new forked project
3. Go to the Trifork github and create a pullrequest

path: /Technology & Software/2. Targit/2.12 Tips and Tricks/2.12.1 Working With Criteria on Large Dimensions
content:
If you ever encounter TARGIT freezing or getting stuck on "Loading data"/"Henter data" or simply nothing happening when working with criteria on larger dimensions it is possible to use TARGITs "Decoration"-feature in TARGIT management. The issue is happening due to TARGIT trying to generate the whole list in the criteria window which for some reason can take incredibly long.
As an example I will use "Posteringstekst" from PRISME365:


Locate "Dekorationer" in TARGIT Management:
![image.png](/.attachments/image-6e4fe2d3-7c86-4757-8e64-b8b03bace568.png)

Check off the "Vis kun specificerede dekorationer":
![image.png](/.attachments/image-deec6648-fa5d-45f0-ae71-45700c02cb71.png)

Locate "Posteringstekst" in the PRISME365 cube: 
![image.png](/.attachments/image-52ba5cba-a149-4d86-a6a3-ae29c84cbc9c.png)

"Kun søgning i kriterielinjen" is as a standard marked to "Nej", but simply just press "Nej" and switch it to "Ja", and proceed by pressing OK in the bottom right corner:
![image.png](/.attachments/image-b7f23777-f861-4292-9e16-a02480807a00.png)


Now TARGIT will not load anything into the criteria list before searching after specific members, and by doing this you do not need to wait for TARGIT to generate the whole list:

![image.png](/.attachments/image-85feae3e-c58b-45f1-ba5c-938020b57cb6.png)

Example below where the criteria list is now generated only based on my search:

![image.png](/.attachments/image-e92ae778-08f5-46a4-81ea-26402658446e.png)
![image.png](/.attachments/image-c7d55c6c-29ac-4fec-ad48-0994fa296189.png)

path: /Teams/1. Administrative Domain Team/1.7 FLIS/1.7.2 FLIS 2/Job Description
content:
In each batch we run all four FLIS jobs (download, extract, load, ssas*)

**JOB DOWNLOAD**
STEP 1	Download
- For each area (borger, oekonomi, skole etc.): If sourcefile newer than "H:\FLIS2\$Customername\Sourcedata\area\latestdownload.txt” 
- True: Download area and create a new latestdownload.txt. Go to next area/step 2
- False: Go to next area/step 2

STEP 2	Unzip
- For each area: If "H:\FLIS2\Customername\Sourcedata\area\DM-*.zip” exist
- True: 
Unzip to "H:\FLIS2\Customername\Extracted”. 
Create Extract_$area.txt in "H:\FLIS2\Customername”. 
Remove original .zip and create an empty copy placed in "H:\FLIS2\Customername\Extracted\area”. This is used in TableStatistics.
- False: Quit job

**JOB EXTRACT**
STEP 1	Bulk
- Check if Extract_$area.txt exists in “H:\FLIS2\Customername\”
- True: 
Load files into sql server using bulk insert Extract.ps1..... 
Remove Extract_$area.txt
Create Load_$area.txt
- False: Quit job

**JOB LOAD**
STEP 1	Transfer to iq
- Check if Load_$area.txt exists in “H:\FLIS2\Customername\”
- True: 
Load tabels to IQ server using transfertool (load.ps1.....) 
Remove Load_$area.txt
- False: Quit job

**JOB SSAS**
STEP 1	SSAS PROCESS
- Check if SSAS_$area.txt exists in “H:\FLIS2\Customername\”
- True: 
Process cube (SSAS.ps1.....) 
Remove SSAS_$area.txt
- False: Quit job

*as for now the ssas job is done manually without the use of triggers

path: /Technology & Software/2. Targit/2.2 Internal TARGIT server purposes
content:
In KMD DMBI we have four internal TARGIT servers:

- KMDAPP2237 (172.31.112.31, referred to as .31)
- KMDAPP0138 (172.31.112.36, referred to as .36)
- KMDAPP0108 (172.31.112.87, referred to as .87)
- KMDAPP0142 (172.31.112.29, referred to as .29)

Production server
.31 is our primary production server and it is the host of the [BI Operations Portal](https://targit.intranet.kmdhub.net/touchserver/#vfs://global/Portal/Portal%20Frontpage.xview) as well as supporting solutions, which is a part of or contributes to this portal. Both internal and external reports are being sent from this server e.g. PDF status reports and notifications sent to various Teams channels. We are also planning that selected TARGIT inspirational analyses and reports should be made available on this server through the BI Operations Portal, with anonymized data so they can be used for demo purposes.

Development server
.36 is our primary development server for all development teams. This is where TARGIT ETL-projects, data models and inspirational analyses and reports are being developed and tested. This server can be used by all teams.

TARGIT Platform server
.87 is reserved for TARGIT Platform tasks and projects, which often concerns TARGIT operations and performance. Solutions belonging to the Admin Insights team are also being developed on this server, which is why running versions of related norm cubes and inspirational analyses and reports are also found on this server. In order to ensure combability when deploying inspirational analyses and reports to customers, the installed version of TARGIT on this server might not be the newest, because of lacking backward combability on xview files.

Test server
.29 is a smaller server primarily used for testing purposes, e.g. installation and test of new TARGIT releases.

To logon to these servers, you need a KMDPFOSAP login. If you don't have this login and you still need to access the BI Operations Portal, you can have a local user created on the .31 server (reach out to OCG or CDO if you need this kind of login).

path: /Technology & Software/2. Targit/2.6 Development/2.6.1 Development of Norm Cubes Between Releases
content:
Norm cubes should, like all other projects and solutions, be submitted to GIT version control to ensure full control of changes and revisions to the datamodel and ETL-project and for easy retrieval of the current or previous versions of the solution.

This short guide describes the more practical aspects on working with development on norm cubes between releases.

In PDT3 we have live versions of the norm cube solutions on a TARGIT server, and these have the same connections names as they would have on a customer server, which makes it easier for deployment, especially concerning deployment of inspirational reports, where the connection name is hard coded within the xview file itself:

![norn.png](/.attachments/norn-4d00fee9-4706-438b-a014-3e310afcb4d0.png)

The description also states that these are norm cubes, which is used for inspirational analyses and reports. These connections are only updated, when new official releases are released. In this way, these connections are always the current versions of the latest norm cubes.

When we plan to make changes to a norm cube, eg. new development or bug fixes, we always make a copy of the norm cubes connections, prefixing the the connection name with "Dev", and using the correct versions of the datamodel and ETL project from GIT:

![dev.png](/.attachments/dev-24d5643f-8733-4bee-8130-1aa5ebb1fc9c.png)

The description field is also updated to indicate that norm cubes development is undergoing using this connection. Preferably the developer puts his or hers initials in the description field as well.

When development is tested and done and a release is planned, changes are submitted to GIT and the norm cube connection is updated, which concludes the cycle of norm cube development. 

If no development is planned on the "Dev" connection in the near future, clean up should be done, with removal of the connection and the underlying datamodel and database.

#Introduction

Documentation is essential to our company’s ability to share knowledge, maintain consistency, and ensure smooth operations. It serves as a collective memory that helps us onboard new team members, maintain systems, and develop efficiently. Without clear structure and practices, important information can become disorganized or hard to find.

This manifest outlines the guidelines for organizing, updating, and maintaining our documentation. By following a consistent approach, we ensure that all documentation remains accessible, easy to understand, and up-to-date, supporting our ongoing efforts to improve and adapt quickly.
[[_TOC_]]

---

#Main Guidelines

##Wiki Structure
The wiki is divided into main subjects, each representing a core area of documentation. When creating or updating documentation, ensure that it is placed in the correct subject and follows the implemented structure to maintain clarity and consistency. Additionally, we encourage that all pages contain meaningful content.

As part of our structure, we aim to avoid any blank pages. Please include an introduction on each subject page with a brief description that provides context. This practice enhances the value of our documentation and ensures that every page contributes meaningfully to our collective knowledge.

There’s no need to manually adjust the sorting of files, this will be handled automatically. If your page has subpages, a table of subpages will also be generated as part of our automation process.

## Language & Naming Guidelines
To promote inclusivity and ensure that all internal documentation is accessible across the organization, we require that all documentation be written in English. This approach allows us to reach a broader audience and ensures that everyone has the opportunity to understand and utilize the information effectively.
Pages must also be given descriptive and appropriate names, as the built-in search bar can only search by file names, not page content.

## Numbering System
We use a hierarchical numbering system to organize subpages for clarity and ease of navigation. The first subpage under any main topic is numbered 1., the second 2., and so forth. If a subpage contains its own subpages, they follow the format 1.1, 1.2, 1.3, and so on. To maintain readability, the numbering is limited to three levels (e.g., 1.1.1), and any subpages beyond this level are not numbered. This approach ensures that information remains logically structured and easy to navigate for all users. 

Example:

![image.png](/.attachments/image-73d544ae-57dd-4ab3-a350-fe270fbb3cc0.png)

## Tagging System
Tagging essential documentation, onboarding resources, or guidelines can easily be done using `[#Essential]()`, `[#Onboarding]()`, or `[#Guideline]()`. These tags will automatically generate links and introductions on their corresponding pages. You can add new tag pairs as needed. For more details on how this works or detailed guidance, visit [this page](https://dev.azure.com/kmd-dima/KMD.DIMA.LG/_wiki/wikis/KMD.DIMA.LG.wiki/9089/13.-Wiki-Automation-Scripts). 

## Removal or updating of outdated documentation
Documentation should not be deleted unless there is a clear assurance that it will no longer be needed. Instead, we recommend moving such documents to the Archive section. This approach preserves valuable information while maintaining a clean and accessible documentation structure.

## Maintenance & Ownership
Each team is responsible for the ownership and upkeep of their designated sections within the wiki. For product and service documentation, the teams directly involved with those areas manage the relevant content. The Architecture Office (AO) is responsible for maintaining the Manifesto and Technology, Tools, & Processes pages. While everyone is free to tag a page with the `[#Essential]()` and the [different onboarding tags](https://dev.azure.com/kmd-dima/KMD.DIMA.LG/_wiki/wikis/KMD.DIMA.LG.wiki/8824/Onboarding), AO is also responsible for maintaining these pages. [Automated scripts](https://dev.azure.com/kmd-dima/KMD.DIMA.LG/_wiki/wikis/KMD.DIMA.LG.wiki/9089/13.-Wiki-Automation-Scripts) assist with routine maintenance to ensure some consistency and structure, yet each team remains fully accountable for keeping their documentation accurate and up-to-date.

##External Documentation
When creating documentation intended for both internal and external users, such as customers, we encourage you to store it in SharePoint. Please provide a link to the relevant SharePoint page in the wiki, along with a brief description to ensure easy access and understanding.

##Markdown
Whenever you are creating or editing documentation, you are going to be writing in Markdown.
Markdown is a lightweight markup language that allows you to format text using simple syntax. It is widely used for creating documentation due to its ease of use and readability. With Markdown, you can easily add headings, lists, links, images, and more, enabling you to create structured and organized content without the need for complex formatting tools.
[Here](https://dev.azure.com/kmd-dima/KMD.DIMA.LG/_git/KMD.DIMA.LG.wiki?path=/.templates/markdownexamples.md) you can find a number of basic syntax for designing your documentation, hit preview if you want to see what it would look like on a wiki page!
For more detailed information on how to use Markdown, please refer to the external [Markdown Guide](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/devops/project/wiki/markdown-guidance?view=azure-devops)

# Introduction 

The Change & Feature Request system allows employees to submit issues, improvement ideas, and feature requests for the KMD Insight Platform. It provides a centralized way to report topics related to the data platform, helping DIMA LG prioritize and address both operational and strategic enhancements. The Architecture Office (AO) facilitates the evaluation process, ensuring transparency and involving relevant stakeholders to drive the platform's evolution and support business needs.

---

[[_TOC_]]

## Request dashboard
If you have relevant topics around our data platform and tech stack, both regarding issues and improvement to running applications and requests for new technology, then please use the AO ticket system for submitting you thoughts or ideas. The ticket system can be found [here](https://dev.azure.com/kmd-dima/KMD.DIMA.LG/_dashboards/dashboard/b117211d-459d-4fc9-8823-39992996fd1b).

### Types of requests
- Requests and suggestions for improvements to framework, tools and infrastructure
- New technology opportunities
- New business opportunities with need of adjustment or expansion of current technology stack.
- Potential process automation
- Issues or bugs related to any internal/external components within our data platform.
- Request for guidance and sparring.

### Purpose
The purpose for this ticket system, is for all employees within DIMA LG and other relevant internal stakeholders, to have a place to report relevant topics around our data platform.

This single point of reference, makes it easier for DIMA LG to consider and priorities both operational and strategic enhancement of our common data platform. Both to feed the needs of our customer today and in the future, but also to reduce friction and improve business processes for all employees of DIMA LG.

### Role of DIMA LG Architecture Office (AO)
The responsibility of AO is to facilitate and assess all the incoming requests. AO are not making unanimous decision based on the incoming requests, but make sure to involve all relevant stakeholders to make the right decision and prioritizing. All tickets, prioritization and decisions are open and available for everyone inside our organization.

### Process and flow for reported tickets
After a ticket is created AO (MMP) assess the tickets. When a ticket is assessed it will be moved to AO boards, where it change state to any of the following states:
- **Assessment:** The ticket are assessed and matured.
- **Backlog Assessment:**  The ticket is ready for an assessment on either being rejected or moved to backlog. 
- **Backlog:** Tickets close to our current data platform
- **Backlog Vision:** Tickets of more visionary nature related to our data platform
- **Backlog Prioritized:** Tickets that is prioritized and soon will go into active state.
- **Active:** Tickets that are under development/implementation.
- **Backlog - Rejected:** Things that by any reason will be rejected from the backlog - with a profound cause for this state.
- **Backlog Vision - Rejected:** Visionary tickets around our platform - with a profound cause for this state.
- **Closed:** Finished and closed tickets.

## How to create a ticket
Follow this guideline on how to make a request to AO:
1. Follow this link to the DevOps ticket dashboard https://dev.azure.com/kmd-dima/KMD.DIMA.LG/_dashboards/dashboard/b117211d-459d-4fc9-8823-39992996fd1b
2. Click the blue buttton 'Open a New Ticket'
3. Fill out the Title in the template work item.
4. Fill out the Description element in the newly created work item. The Description element should contain the information requested in the Discussion panel of the item.
5. Make sure the Area is set to 'KMD.DIMA.LG\Other projects\Architecture Office'.
6. Make sure the Iteration is set to 'KMD.DIMA.LG'

The ticket is now created in the AO backlog board and will then be processed. When change of status, need for additional questions or other relevant information regarding the ticket the ticket creator will be notified/tagged in the ticket.

Thanks for involving in the improvement of DIMA LG.

# Introduction  
The Products & Services section serves as a repository of documentation for all products and services developed with the customer as the primary focus. This includes internal descriptions, technical specifications, and detailed information about tools and systems that support our customer-driven solutions, such as DSA, Dataarea, DM and various modules. Each entry contains the content of the repository's `README.md` file.
At the top of each page, a link to the related repository will be available.

In [this Sharepoint document](https://kmddk.sharepoint.com/:x:/s/Dima-365/Eaq7nvh-NRVIvwg_fCg546sB10tVPkdIH2BOa1eAflboeA?e=V2xThf) the ownership of all our products and services are listed, you can also find frequently updated information about the products & services platform, support managers and more. 

## How to Use  
The table below lists the products and services with their corresponding technical and friendly names. For each entry:
- A folder will be automatically created based on the technical and friendly names.
- The script searches for repositories that contain the technical name and, if located, generates documentation based on the repository's `README.md` file, naming it after the repository. Additionally, the page is placed in a subfolder defined in the repository's `doc.config` file. 
- If any of the products has external documentation, please provide a link in the third column, it will automatically be put on the subfolders page as well. 

By simply adding entries to the table, folders and pages are automatically generated and updated, ensuring that all information remains organized and accessible. The script that automatically scans repositories is triggered by changes on this page, or in its subfolders. However if you changed something in a `README.md` file and you want the wiki updated immediately, you can run the script manually [by following this link](https://dev.azure.com/kmd-dima/KMD.DIMA.LG/_build?definitionId=5347), and click 'Run Pipeline' in the top right corner, otherwise the script runs automatically once a day.

## Connect to the endpoint
![image.png](/.attachments/image-334a0c9c-1647-4066-b502-3a25a1462ff4.png)

1. Call "Get practitioner-realm-info" to get assertion token
2. Call "Post issue-service-account-token" to connect via openid to get a access_token token
3. Call "Post authorize-service-account" to authenticate with the access_token and get a session token.
4. Call "Post list-audit-events" with paremeters set in body to get data

const private_key = bru.getEnvVar("PrivateKey");

const j_payload = {
  jti: uuidv4(),
  iss: bru.getEnvVar("ClientId"),
  sub: bru.getEnvVar("ClientId"),
  aud: bru.getVar("tokenUrl"),
  iat: Math.floor(Date.now() / 1000),
  exp: Math.floor(Date.now() / 1000) + 3600
}

const s_payload = JSON.stringify(j_payload);

const jwt_signed = KJUR.jws.JWS.sign("RS256", JSON.stringify({alg: "RS256"}), s_payload, private_key);

bru.setVar("clientAssertion", jwt_signed);

# Data Source
Data is received daily on IM-P in XML format bundled in a ZIP archive file. 
It is then processed and dynamically loaded into the extract layer of the customers DSA using a powershell script called Dubu_Extract.ps1.
There is an extract table in DSA for every XML file.
The powershell script has three stages: XSD Schema sync, ZIP extraction and XML file processing.
The XSD schema sync step dynamically adjusts extract table definitions if the source data (XML files) have changed format since the last load.
The XML file processing iterates over all the unzipped XML files and bulkloads them to their respective extract table.
After Extract, the data is full loaded to Archive using standard Framework processes, meaning that no delta is retained in the Archive layer.

# Introduction

KMD INSIGHT KY, is made up of data from the KY system. This system from Kombit controls the payment of certain public services paid by the municipalities. This applies to both payments to citizens and companies.

Access to the universes presupposes that the user has access as a report developer or statistics user. The KMD standard time dimension is used in all universes, resulting in a uniform approach to the time dimension. Not all elements in the standard time dimension can necessarily be used in relation to the individual universe, but it follows from the fact that this is a common standard time dimension that is used in many different places. For example, the dimension School year is included, even though it does not make sense in relation to data from KY.

Documentation on the latest version of KY can be found here: https://kmddk.sharepoint.com/sites/Dima-365/Delte%20dokumenter/Forms/AllItems.aspx?FolderCTID=0x0120007E96A0A0A2F41747A73853F4D2D9C4C4&isAscending=false&id=%2Fsites%2FDima%2D365%2FDelte%20dokumenter%2FGeneral%2F05%20F%C3%A6lleskommunale%20L%C3%B8sninger%2FKY%2FDokumentation&sortField=Modified&viewid=2d2179a1%2D6ce0%2D4272%2D8741%2D5932ad72e0ed

[[_TOC_]]

## Data
Data is retrieved from Kombit's **service platform** and entered into the KMD data warehouse (DW), where a municipality with the SAP Business Objects (BO) tool can extract the desired information. The structure with universes and reports ensures that data is processed and presented in a form that the average user can go to. Recognizability in naming from the subject system is sought.

The data basis in KMD INSIGHT KY contains information based on the municipality's registrations in the source system (KY). The content of dimensions is therefore based on the individual municipality's application.


The field in the universe "Update frequency" which is found in the folder General info, shows the frequency with which data is updated. Data is received once daily from Kombit. Kombit makes the data available and KMD then updates the data on the same day. However, some municipalities only have weekly or monthly data deliveries.


The history in KMD Insight KY starts from the day the municipality transfers from Aktiv to KY. Cases that were open in Aktiv are also included in the historic data.


The data extract from Kombit only includes civil registration number. KMD Insight KY is enriched with supplementary personal data. Right now this happens for all connected municipalities with KMD P-data as a source - including also for citizens residing in other municipalities. When KMD P-data ceases as a solution, the enrichment presupposes that the Customer also has access to KMD Insight Citizen - and it can not be guaranteed that data can be retrieved for citizens residing in other municipalities.

## Authorizations

In KMD INSIGHT KY universes, any user with access to the universe has access to view data regarding their own municipality.

## Solution Architecture
KY follows a custom DSA and traditional DataArea jobflow with extract (based on powershell and DSA_SSIS_GENERIC), transform and load.

More information can be found here:
https://kmddk.sharepoint.com/:w:/s/Dima-365/EVSn4o0CJ4hEnTSPkzC3uTYBY0MggZ3W0HIgDzk7mSjwCA?e=pucY6w

Documentation for operation of

Momentum Focus

 

 

Created date:

20-09-2023

Maciej Wojciechowski

4.     Special circumstances 6

 

1.              Purpose

The purpose of this document is to ensure, that operation has the necessary information to maintain operation, solve issues and add new customers for the solution it relates to.

 

Momentum focus is a global solution responsible for uploading reports to azure blobs. It is doing that for all customers and reports defined in a configuration.

2.              Solution

Description of relevant technical aspects of the solution.

Modules

List of modules which is contained in this solution:

 

Module name

Backend
Expert(s)

Product owner

Type
(Internal/Customer/Product)

global_dsa_momentumfocus

 MPC

 

Product

 

Modules this solution relates to but which is not directly a part of the solution itself:

·         001_log_ms: Used for logging purposes. Must be installed individually for each customer.

·         001_common_ms: Used for common dimensions. Must be installed individually for each customer.

 

Source systems

Solution is made to upload reports generated in SAP. Those reports are created using Momentum data. Jobs on SAP generate reports and upload them to intftp.

 

Reports show data from Momentum source system. Description of reports can be found:

 

Momentum Focus dokumentation.docx

 

Source data and delivery of data

Jobs on SAP are responsible for generating reports and uploading them to intftp server. Each Kommune have a different folder on intftp which is containing one or many different reports. SAP jobs are running everyday, and reports are replaced with a new version. Each report is a zip file which is containing one or many csv files. Our solution is responsible to upload reports from intftp to azure blob servers prod and tests. Momentum Focus job is checking if new reports arrived, when that condition is made it is uploading them to azure blobs. Our code is checking if data for specific customer in Momentum is updated. If that condition is made and reports are not delivered to intftp, We are sending a mail with that information.

 

Dataflow

Momentum focus is a custom solution with two custom jobs.

 

 

One for prod and one for test. Prod job is uploading reports with production data for all customers. Test job is uploading anonymized reports. Both are calling PowerShell script, but with a different parameter.

 

 

 

Requirements: script uses WinSCP in minimal version 5.17 so it needs to be installed on the sever

 

·         MF_downloadData.ps1

Description: Script is executed from both prod and test jobs. In first step it is reading configuration parameters from database. Next step is to prepare list of customers and reports which should be delivered. Then it is checking which reports are ready and it is downloading them to share \\195.50.39.199\im-p\MOMENTUMFOCUS-Import\. On that share We have separate folders for prod and tests. Inside both there are folders with Kommune numbers. Script is downloading each report to IN folder in Kommune folder. When files are ready in ‘IN’ folder script is uploading them to azure blob. If that operation is made with success reports are moved from ‘IN’ to ‘Arch’ folder and timestamp is added to file name.

 

 

Backup files

All uploaded reports are archived in ‘Arch’ folders on \\195.50.39.199\im-p\MOMENTUMFOCUS-Import

Test environment

For test data there is a special test jobs which is running on Production. It is moving test reports with anonymized data to azure blob test.

 

SFTP info

INTFTP:

Host name: intftp.kmd.dk

User name: momentumfocus

Password is in file MOMENTUMFOCUS_INTFTP.password

 

AZURE BLOB PROD:

Host name: kmdexternalmomentumfocus.blob.core.windows.net

User name: kmdexternalmomentumfocus.focus

Password is in file MOMENTUMFOCUS_PROD_AZURE.password

 

 

AZURE BLOB TEST:

Host name: kmdinternalmomentumfocus.blob.core.windows.net

User name: kmdinternalmomentumfocus.focus

Password is in file MOMENTUMFOCUS_TEST_AZURE.password

 

INTFTP browser access:

https://intftp.kmd.dk/webclient/Login.xhtml

Job schedule

GLOBAL_BI_MOMENTUMFOCUS_UPLOADPROD – daily

GLOBAL_BI_MOMENTUMFOCUS_UPLOADTEST – daily

 

SAP BO universes

All momentum universes are included in Momentum Focus solution.

 

SAP BO Universes are:

 

 

Documentation that describes universes can be found here:

 

KMD Momentum Insight - Universdokumentation - v. 19.pdf

Not relevant.

 

Documentation

3.              Operation

In this part any information needed to maintain smooth operation is detailed.

Installation only one global module

Data request

New reports should be ordered in SAP (contact daa@kmd.dk).

 

Reports setup in Momentum Focus

All reports that We should processed must be configured in GLOBAL_MOMENTUMFOCUS_01_DSA database. To change a configuration developer need to change stored procedure [config].[addCustomerReportMaster]. In that procedure We are defining all reports for all customers.

Technical setup

WinSCP needs to be updated to version 5.17 or higher once per server.

001_log_ms module needs to be upgraded to version 1.0.017 or higher once per customer

Files MOMENTUMFOCUS_INTFTP.password, MOMENTUMFOCUS_PROD_AZURE.password, MOMENTUMFOCUS_TEST_AZURE.password should be placed in %KMDHOME%\Config\global_dsa_momentumfocus. PowerShell scripts needs to be installed on a server it is included in module globabinfolder. Port opening for sftp connection to intftp, azure blob prod and azure blob test

## Environments mapping 

| Momentum Source      | ETL Server            | ETL Client | IQ role | IQ Env |
|--------------------- |----------------------|------------|---------|--------|
| rct-momentum-791     | kdidmssdb02 dev 2     | 159        | 159     | Dev    |
| test-momentum-791    | kdidmssdb02 dev 2     | 791        | 791     | Dev    |
| prod-momentum-791    | kdidmssdb01 dev 1     | 791        | 791p    | Dev    |
| prod-momentum-791    | KDITMSSDB01 test 1    | 791        | 999     | Prod   |

---

## Customer change on the way to IQ
Both 791p and 999 use a special load job setup with a dedicated parameter file. Because of this, the customer number changes between the ETL server and IQ. It also requires a dedicated log database: 999_00_LOG on KDITMSSDB01 and 791p_00_LOG on kdidmssdb01. Additionally, the parameter file that moves data to 999 uses the production IQ as its destination.

---

## Focus test dependencies
As requested in [Feature 183952](https://dev.azure.com/kmd-dima/KMD.DIMA.LG/_workitems/edit/183952), Momentum Focus needed an environment with partially scrambled data. The scrambled data can be found on role_999 on the PROD environment in order to be used by reports residing on the production BO instance. The ETL implementation can be found in the below commits:
[momentum.dsa.001 changes 0c0de899](https://dev.azure.com/kmd-dima/KMD.DIMA.LG/_git/momentum.dsa.001/commit/0c0de899e7aa37d4e3d0c3a295c7d21ccc31cc60)

content:
## Introduction

Detailed information about the project can be found [here](https://kmddk.sharepoint.com/:f:/s/Dima-365/ErRQgH1kSXZNg2FDODJY04gBMjiTE5UgAFByUbzIFpHg8Q?e=fccJiJ).

### Data

The same as in Joblog.
Data is shared on the SFTP server, in form of CSV files (packed in zip repositories). After logging to SFTP we can Subfolders called in pattern {3 digit municipality code}-{two digit solution code}, for example 580-04. 2-digit code is used as cross-identification as a link to SUP documentation. Under each Data Areas are 2 folders, one with "Delta" deliveries, one with one set of "Full" deliveries. Grupper is under directory 04. 

Data is delivered in two ways - full and delta. Full deliveries take place one a month, each delivery contains all existing data. Delta deliveries should be taking place once a week but regarding to problems with data quality, delta deliveries are not used. 

Both in full and delta deliveries there are files with same names and with or without TILFLYNING at the end. In the TILFLYNING files there is history from previous municipality of Citizens, who has just moved in to the current one. Also there are files with History in their names, the are not currently used.

Data in source files is delimited with ¤|¤|¤ symbols, some fields contain "" symbol, there are no text quantifiers. Additionally in one of the files there was a CRLF indicating row break in the middle of the record. Due to this problem there is a additional step in PowerShell scripts - field delimiter and row delimiter are changed, "" is swapped to '', text quantifiers are added. Files in this form are loaded to DSA.


### Authorizations

Credentials required to connect to the SFTP Server are saved on the [SecretServer](https://passwords.kmd.dk/SecretServer/login.aspx?ReturnUrl=%2FSecretServer%2Fapp%2F%23%2F).

## Modules

List of modules which are contained in the solution:
| Module name | Backend developer | Product owner | Type |
|--|--|--|--|
| 001_dsa_joblog  | PYO | SRA |Product   |
| 001_dataarea_joblog  | PYO | SRA |  Product |
| 001_dsa_codelist | MJL, PYO | SRA | Product |

Modules this solution relates to but which is not directly a part of the solution itself:

- 001_log_ms: Used for logging purposes. Must be installed individually for each customer.
- 001_common_ms: Used for common dimensions. Must be installed individually for each customer.
- 001_FOLKEREG_DSA: Connected via Linked Server.
- 001_GEOADRESSE_EDW: Connected via Linked Server.


## Solution Architecture

GRUPPER follows a custom DSA_SSIS_TXT_GENERIC and traditional DataArea architecture jobflow with extract (based on PowerShell and DSA_SSIS_TXT_GENERIC), transform, load.

PowerShell was adjusted to perform some additional operations in order to reformat received data and adjust it to the standard Framework workflow. The load job runs JOBLOG_DSA PowerShell script, it needs to be run as server_sqlagent, steps of the scripts are:
- establishing connection to sftp
- checking if there are new files on sftp (compares dates from file names and date from files previously loaded to the DSA)
- checking if all files are ready on sftp
- cleaning InZip directory and downloading files
- cleaning UnZip directory and extracting zip
- cleaning IN folder, processing unzipped files (delimiter is changed, header removed, text quantifiers added) and moving the to IN directory
- Running SSIS
- checking if DSAdatefrom was archived in logs
- archiving zip files in arch directory

## Schedule
It runs 5th,10th days in month (Monthly load).

## Universes

Currently there are two universes in the solution, ContactGroup and Enrollment.

**ContactGroup**:
- facts
    - ContactGroup
    - IF_Citizen_GeoAdresse
- dimensions
    - ContactGroup
    - ContactGroupType
    - Citizen
    - AuthorityType

**Enrollment**:
- facts
    - Enrollment
    - IF_Citizen_GeoAdresse
- dimensions
    - Enrollment
    - Citizen
    - ClientCategoryType
    - CurrentUnemploymentStatus
    - UnemploymentFund
    - UnemploymentInsuranceCategory
    - RemovalCause
    - UserType
    - ActiveOrganisation
    - UserOrganization

**Dimension Citizen** is based on CPR number from the 09_tblCprPersonId and 09_tblCprPersonId_TILFLYTNING source files, rest of data is fetched from tables [archive].[FOLKEREG_EDW_BORGER_BOSÆTTELSE], [archive].[FOLKEREG_EDW_BORGER_OPLYSNINGER] and [archive].[FOLKEREG_EDW_VEJREGISTER], which come from module [001_FOLKEREG_DSA].[GLOBAL_FOLKEREG_01_DSA] accessed via LinkedServer.

**Dimension GeoAdresse** is a usual implementation of GeoAdresse, exisiting in most solutions, data are fetched from [dimension].[GeoAdresse] from module [001_GEOADRESSE_EDW].[GLOBAL_GEOADRESSE_02_EDW] accessed via LinkedServer.

Dimensions and fact ContactGroup and Enrollment require data from both base and Tilflytning tables. Merging the data happens in the Work tables. Data in base and Tilflytning is supposed to not have any common part, but such case is handled so any identical rows shouldn't be stored twice.

Most of the dimensions come from the Codelist. All data from Codelist is aggregated in WorkCodelist table, then this table is filtered and dimensions are populated. 

As delta loads doesn't work, we use only full loads once per month. To not load all the data from scratch we delete rows from dimension, which are not present in the current load. This operation is made in procedures with dimension schema.

# Frequent problem

After releases of DSA module (especially initial releases) Extract job may fail throwing an error connected with Substring function in PowerShell script, it is due to wrong encoding of STARGRUPPER_Functions.ps1 file, that should be present in Bin directory. Encoding should be set to UTF-8-BOM, it doesn't work with UTF8. Source of the problem is delimiter hardcoded in line 394 of the file, it important to check if delimiter looks fine. 

Encoding of file is changed during building a release, therefore its hard to avoid this error.

In SAP BO version this solution has 3 universes. Targit version was created at least in 2019 and it doesn't reflect 1-1 what there is in SAP BO. The most important aspect which distinguish this solution from the other is existing of few cubes as a final result (not just one as usually) as a data sources in frontend.

Main difference between our home-made solutions and UnoUng, which came to PDT5 during last year (or even in 2022) is that it consists of 3 separate cubes in frontend. 
It means that first of all to create something inside Targit application we need to decide on which part of the solution we're interested in. Then as shown on the picture below we need to click and choose our chosen cube:


![image.png](/.attachments/image-23218cc2-28ea-44bd-b720-afda9150e7eb.png)

Then depending on chosen cube we have different subset of dimensions to pick up from:


![image.png](/.attachments/image-51e7983e-1ab3-45ed-b54d-cea2bddd775c.png)![image.png](/.attachments/image-f1af56da-5187-4355-8af7-dc22e28c2096.png)![image.png](/.attachments/image-7aa13e8d-b9ce-42b1-a4f9-146ea3673c4d.png)


It makes it impossible or at least not an easy task to create cross universes analysis (combine some dimensions with measures from more than one cube), what is a basic functionality why BI solutions like this are created for.
It all came as a result of making 6 cubes in TARGIT (one virtual cube consisting of four regular cubes (main one called PlaceringMaaned and three 'smaller' created from intermediate facts [Brobygning + Praktik + Uddannelsesplan]) and two individual cubes [Kontakt + Vejledning]) reflecting in that way SAP BO version (see picture below).


![image.png](/.attachments/image-f5807b41-4c73-4617-86c6-2dccae3ec303.png)


The 'smaller' ones had to be created, because there are measures, which are basing on them. 
NOTE: There is no other way to create a measure in TARGIT than to create it based on main fact based on which cube was created. 

### ![image.png](/.attachments/image-65fbaa44-a6c1-4f5f-a152-298fa3b4b667.png)
 _Placering tab which presents what's behind virtual cube._


Another interesting topic is content of virtual cube. It has every single dimension inside it, but the authors of the solution "forget" on purpose or just by mistake to include in it measures from intermediate facts.

![image.png](/.attachments/image-866a3904-b4d2-4f00-b0b6-ef3ef0160cac.png)

The reason to exclude them could be making it easier for the end user to create a report based on this already complicated solution. Because in other way the customer need to remember to not mix measure from particular 'smaler' cube with any other measure as well as to don't use with it anything else than just dimensions coming from the only one display folder on which that cube consists of.

![image.png](/.attachments/image-698f8fb1-d3b2-446e-8ff2-cdca4b33484a.png)

But then unexplainable for me is why we created at all Placering virtual cube consisting of 4 different cubes.

NOTE: Currently the connection string for this solution is made based on 615, but it is only db structure without any data inside it.

# **Azure DevOps i PDT3**

## **Backloggens struktur**

Det Administrative Domænes backlog kan tilgås i Azure DevOps [HER](https://dev.azure.com/kmd-dima/KMD.DIMA.LG/_backlogs/backlog/Administrative%20Domain/Theme). Backloggen angiver det øverste hierarkiske niveau, der er kendetegnet ved samtlige af de produkter/løsninger, der falder under det administrative domæne.

I Azure DevOps skelner vi mellem 5 forskellige Backlog Items, der danner det hiearki, som backloggen på det Administrative Domæne er bygget efter. Disse 5 Backlog Items er:

* Theme: Produktet/løsningen 
* Epic: En kategorisering over opgavernes art. Herunder om opgaverne relaterer sig til Development, Maintenance, Support, Operations eller Implementation. En detaljeret beskrivelse af hvordan disse er defineret kan findes under 'Oversigt over definitioner på Epics'
* Feature: Viser en større funktion for produktet/løsningen 
* User Story: Viser en beskrivelse af det arbejde, der skal udføres.
* Task: Dele af det arbejde, der skal udføres, for at løse en User Story
* Bug: Fejl

_Eksempel på en opgave, der er blevet oprettet på backloggen:_

![image.png](/.attachments/image-04c1187c-b232-4261-966a-b5dc8997f8e8.png)

### Oversigt over definitioner på Epics
Beskrivelsen af hvilke Backlog Items, der skal lægges ind under hver enkelt epic for de forskellige løsninger/produkter, kan findes ved at klikke ind på den enkelte epic i nedenstående visning

![image.png](/.attachments/image-ef2069d9-bc0d-468a-b4bd-7546ede0685e.png)

**Development:** Udviklings- og software relaterede aktiviteter til udviklingsprojekter for produkter. Eksempelvis det første udviklingsprojekt, større ændringer eller tilføjelser.

**Maintenance:** Planlagte ændringer, forbedringer eller mindre tilføjelser af en eksisterende løsning. Eksempelvis ny funktionalitet, ændringer der sikrer at en eksisterende funktionalitet er tilgængelig efter ændringer af datakilder samt juridiske ændringer eller ændringer i kundebehovet.

**Support:** Arbejde, der ikke kan planlægges, relateret til den fortsatte funktion af den enkelte løsning. Herunder visitering, besvarelse af supportspørgsmål samt løsning af problemer i produktmiløet, løsning af mindre problemer eller hjælp til at bruge løsningen (hvis kontraktligt forpligtiget).

**Operations:** Arbejde, der relaterer sig til tekniske dag-til-dag drift at løsningen. Herunder overvågning at natlige kørsler, genkørsler og orientering om gentagende fejl til tekniske eksperter, overvågning af server og infrastruktur samt DevOps og DataOps arbejde.

**Implementation:** Arbejde reltaeret til at give en kunde adgang til en løsning, opsætning af en løsning samt anmodning om data til nye kunder osv. Derudover skal konsulentarbejde og implementering i form af træning registreres her, ved mindre der er lavet andre aftaler om betaling (som eksempelvis klippekort). 

## **SAP Registrering/Klippekort**

I Azure DevOps er tidsregistrering integreret til SAP. Derfor er det vigtigt, at der for alle Backlog Items er angivet et SAP Project, SAP Network og en SAP Operation. Angivet nedenfor er et eksempel for et Backlog Item under Opus Løn og Personale 

![image.png](/.attachments/image-ac02a801-57a6-43bf-a240-fafa3cc88797.png)

Den hierarkiske struktur i backloggen gælder ligeledes for registreringen i SAP. Dermed vil alle nyoprettede Backlog Items som standard nedarve sin 'Parents' registreringsoplysninger. Det kan dog være nødvendigt, at man aktivt selv skal gå ind og ændre på et Backlog Items registrering. Dette kunne eksempelvis være i tilfælde af, at der skal oprettes en opgave på en given løsning, f.eks. Opus Økonomi, men hvor det er aftalt med kunden, at der skal faktureres for opgaven på deres klippekort. For at være sikker på, at tiden bliver faktureret på kundens klippekort, skal man: 

* Klikke på det Backlog Items hvor man registrerer sin tid
* Trykke på 'KMD Timesheet'
* Redigere 'SAP project', 'SAP Network' og 'SAP Operation' så det i stedet for løsningen (nedarvet registrering) viser oplysningerne for klippekortet.

_Se nedenstående eksempel på Skanderborgs Klippekort:_  

![image.png](/.attachments/image-261b83ca-28c9-4016-897f-69cab15bce0a.png)

Oversigten over de aktuelle klippekort i DMBI kan tilgås i Power BI i Teams-gruppen via denne sti: KMD DATA - DMBI - (365) / General / Klippekort eller ved at trykke [HER](https://teams.microsoft.com/l/entity/1c4340de-2a85-40e5-8eb0-4f295368978b/_djb2_msteams_prefix_2968189699?context=%7B%22channelId%22%3A%2219%3A56b1c5ad3f554b7089efef52a757582b%40thread.tacv2%22%7D&tenantId=1e2ad6d6-274f-43e8-89ef-d36d65bb83b5). I første omgang vil det være påkrævet, at man anmoder om adgang til at tilgå oversigten.

# **Oprettelse af opgaver**

## **Hvem opretter hvad**

I PDT3 er det besluttet, at der er følgende retningslinjer for oprettelse af Backlog Items, herunder hvilke man må oprette i den rolle man besidder i teamet: 

* TL: Themes, Epics, Features, User Stories, Tasks og Bugs
* PO/PL: Features, User Stories, Tasks og Bugs
* Developers: Primært Tasks og Bugs, men somme tider User Stories

## **Hvor/Hvornår/Hvordan oprettes opgaver (Udvikling)**

Oversigten over opgaver, der ligger prioriterede og klar i det nuværende Sprint og som danner grundlag for Sprint Planning-mødet kan findes [HER](https://dev.azure.com/kmd-dima/KMD.DIMA.LG/_queries/query/8ac876ed-e642-4953-9acf-fa08e728cfb9/). Når man på Sprint planning har påtaget sig ansvaret for at tage del i løsningen af en opgave, vil man blive tagget i den enkelte User Story mhp. at nedbryde opgaven yderligere i tasks. 

Måden hvorpå man tilgår User Stories for yderlige nedbrydning, kan være gennem Tags (der sendes en mail, når man bliver tagget), gennem sit Sprint view eller gennem Domæne-backloggen.

Når man har klikket sig ind på den enkelte User Story og vil oprette en task, vælger man 'Add link'. Se nedenstående eksempel:

![image.png](/.attachments/image-e7db5de2-d634-47a7-b1d7-fe947297db88.png)

Derefter får man følgende muligheder for at definere det Backlog Item man ønsker at oprette. Ud fra forudsætningen om, at vi ønsker at oprette Tasks under en given User Story, vælger vi nedenstående og trykker 'OK':
* Link type = 'Child' 
* Work item type = 'Task'
* Titel = Beskrivelse af opgaven

![image.png](/.attachments/image-4215fc10-3742-43dd-8c3c-2afe3a3a5743.png)

Derefter skal vi sikre os, at 'Area' og 'Iteration' er korrekte. Disse nedarves fra den User Story, der er oprettet under, på samme måde som 'KMD Timesheet'. For at User Stories og Tasks fremgår af PDT3's overblik, skal der være valgt følgende:

- Area = 'KMD.DIMA.LG\Team areas\PDT3
- Iteration (hvis sprint 24.10) = KMD.DIMA.LG\24.10 

Dernæst angives estimatet på Tasken og der trykkes 'Save & Close'.

![image.png](/.attachments/image-8836c74e-b2f6-4e0d-93de-a93d963fcbf1.png)

## **Oprettelse af Supportsager**

Når man bliver tildelt en Supportsag i Service Now, oprettes der ligeledes en opgave i Azure DevOps. Supportsager oprettes under de User Stories, der benyttes til Support-relaterede aktiviteter. Dette kan gøres ved at oprette en Task eller en Bug under de relevante User Stories. Oversigten med links fremgår nedenfor. 

Når opgaven oprettes, skal der angives links begge steder. Når links angives gøres det på følgende måde:

* Azure DevOps: Taskens/buggens titel navngives som løsningen, en beskrivende tekst efterfulgt af sagsnummeret. 
Eksempelvis: 'Opus Løn og Personale - Rettelse af fejl - CSXXXXXXX'
* Service Now: I 'Work notes (Private)' angives taskens/buggens ID.

**Oversigt/links til Support User Stories, hvor der kan oprettes opgaver (tasks/bugs) for løsninger tilhørende det administrative domæne:**

Det er derudover muligt at ændre visningen i sit [Sprint](https://dev.azure.com/kmd-dima/KMD.DIMA.LG/_sprints/taskboard/PDT3/KMD.DIMA.LG/24.10)  view, så sprintet i stedet vises ud fra User Stories fremfor Personer. content:
[[_TOC_]]




**!!! FROM SEPTEMBER 2025 FLIS OLAP IS NO LONGER UPDATED !!!**




# Setup
A database has been created to manage the deployment of the OLAP databases. 
It is located on KMDDBS2140 and is called KMDFLISOlap

The database contains 2 tables:

[config].[kommune]
[config].[processering]


## [config]. [kommune]
Contains metadata about cube deployment
- **[nummer]** municipality number
- **[navn]** name
- **[server]** server for DM data
- **[OLAPserver]** server cube must be deployed to
- **[impersoneringskonto]** account with which the cube must be processed
- **[password]** password
- **[administratorrolle]** XMLA script with customer roles
- _[dynamisktid]_ not in use
- **[skal_opdateres]** marking whether the customer should be deployed;
- **[skal_opdateres_roller]** marking whether roles should be added (cannot run on DEV)
- _[adminstratorrolle_std]_ not in use


## [config].[processering]

**[kommunenummer]** If a municipality needs its own script, an entry is created here
**[version]** is used for reference only. The SSIS package does not recognize.
**[kode]** XMLA script to process the cube with


# Base files
When a new release is published on the FLIS website ([link](https://www.eflis.dk/dataomrader/generelt/overblik-over-tidligere-releases/)) the OLAP project must be downloaded and unpacked.

In the folder 'Output', these 4 files must be retrieved and placed in the same folder as the .ps programs

![image.png](/.attachments/image-360fe2d2-79ff-48b5-a494-3560a782863b.png)


# Dynamic Time
Before the cubes can be deployed, the OLAP project must be modified to include Dynamic Time.
This is currently done as a manual step.

**Attribute relationships**
Open the OLAP.asdatabase script and find the 

'<ID>Dim Tid ID</ID>'

As the last relationship (indicated by the gray lines), insert the following:

********************************
                        <AttributeRelationship>
                            <AttributeID>Dato 1</AttributeID>
                            <Name>DT Dato</Name>
                        </AttributeRelationship>

********************************
![image.png](/.attachments/image-feb6253d-83eb-419c-bd4a-22102ffcc160.png)

**Attributes**
Next, attributes should be inserted as the last in the row.
Find the place where attributes stop and hierarchies begin, i.e. the first
   
<Hierarchies>

.
tag after where 'Date 1' is inserted.

![image.png](/.attachments/image-b4102313-70d8-4092-9ff0-00a97c97a7b9.png)

and paste the following

********************************
                <Attribute>
                    <ID>Dato 1</ID>
                    <Name>DT Dato</Name>
                    <Type>Days</Type>
                    <KeyColumns>
                        <KeyColumn>
                            <DataType>Date</DataType>
                            <Source xsi:type="ColumnBinding">
                                <TableID>Fælles_DimTidView</TableID>
                                <ColumnID>Dato</ColumnID>
                            </Source>
                        </KeyColumn>
                    </KeyColumns>
                    <NameColumn>
                        <DataType>WChar</DataType>
                        <Source xsi:type="ColumnBinding">
                            <TableID>Fælles_DimTidView</TableID>
                            <ColumnID>DimTidID</ColumnID>
                        </Source>
                    </NameColumn>
                    <AttributeRelationships>
                        <AttributeRelationship>
                            <AttributeID>Måned I År 2</AttributeID>
                            <Name>DT Måned</Name>
                        </AttributeRelationship>
                    </AttributeRelationships>
                </Attribute>
                <Attribute>
                    <ID>Måned I År 2</ID>
                    <Name>DT Måned</Name>
                    <Type>Months</Type>
                    <KeyColumns>
                        <KeyColumn>
                            <DataType>Integer</DataType>
                            <Source xsi:type="ColumnBinding">
                                <TableID>Fælles_DimTidView</TableID>
                                <ColumnID>År</ColumnID>
                            </Source>
                        </KeyColumn>
                        <KeyColumn>
                            <DataType>Integer</DataType>
                            <Source xsi:type="ColumnBinding">
                                <TableID>Fælles_DimTidView</TableID>
                                <ColumnID>MånedIÅr</ColumnID>
                            </Source>
                        </KeyColumn>
                    </KeyColumns>
                    <NameColumn>
                        <DataType>WChar</DataType>
                        <DataSize>15</DataSize>
                        <Source xsi:type="ColumnBinding">
                            <TableID>Fælles_DimTidView</TableID>
                            <ColumnID>MånedNavn</ColumnID>
                        </Source>
                    </NameColumn>
                    <AttributeRelationships>
                        <AttributeRelationship>
                            <AttributeID>År</AttributeID>
                            <Name>År</Name>
                        </AttributeRelationship>
                    </AttributeRelationships>
                    <OrderBy>Key</OrderBy>
                </Attribute>	

********************************


**Hierarchies**
Find the place where hierarchies end

(search for:  </Hierarchies>)

 and paste the following just above (the place is marked in gray)

![image.png](/.attachments/image-b4b2edee-9485-4e40-bf25-a97bd04c0d33.png)

********************************
                <Hierarchy>
                    <ID>KMDHierarchy 3</ID>
                    <Name>DT År-Måned-Dato</Name>
                    <Description>#|Timedef:[<>].&[<YYYY]&[MM>].[<YYYYMMDD>]|# </Description>
                    <Levels>
                        <Level>
                            <ID>År</ID>
                            <Name>År</Name>
                            <SourceAttributeID>År</SourceAttributeID>
                        </Level>
                        <Level>
                            <ID>DT Måned</ID>
                            <Name>DT Måned</Name>
                            <SourceAttributeID>Måned I År 2</SourceAttributeID>
                        </Level>
                        <Level>
                            <ID>DT Dato</ID>
                            <Name>DT Dato</Name>
                            <SourceAttributeID>Dato 1</SourceAttributeID>
                        </Level>
                    </Levels>
                </Hierarchy>

********************************

# Deployment
Cubes

Run the 'DeployCubes.ps1' script from the folder 'E:\KMD\FLIS_AutoDeploy' on KMDAPP0140.

Specify which version of FLIS is deployed. This is just a text that is put as a description on the cube. For example, enter '6.3' or '6.3 (release 30.07.2021) if you know the release date. 

New cube projects can quickly appear, so it can be nice to know which edition is installed.

The cube is deployed to the customers selected in [config]. [kommune]
![image.png](/.attachments/image-3a4331e3-e8c5-45f5-9a25-75b8dbcee5d5.png)

Check other columns per customer to ensure deployment to the correct environment. Any existing databases will be overwritten without notice.

**Roles**
If deployed to production, roles must also be put on. The role script is also in the table. Run the DeployCubes_Roles.ps1 script. The script runs through the table and updates for the customers that are selected.
![image.png](/.attachments/image-8b283e50-cd62-4f61-9f97-8aa0c5f9426c.png)



# Data Check
Part of the script is to ensure that all references to 'Kommunenumre' are changed.

To make sure that all instances have been changed, a check can be performed:

Match the number of results from this

![image.png](/.attachments/image-cada847e-48a8-479b-9ff4-b4e768e1403a.png)

with this

![image.png](/.attachments/image-6bfb8576-fa7d-4d3e-80f0-f8ddef6a7d95.png)

Make sure to mark search as RegEx
![image.png](/.attachments/image-c67f50e3-0f51-4d5e-8ca2-3364ce2d7b99.png)

In this case both match 67, and therefore we are sure that all references are translated:
![image.png](/.attachments/image-669d8001-1092-46b7-9362-317e25c9988b.png)




# Processering - NOT ACTUAL ANY LONGER
The SSIS package is structured so that it retrieves XMLA processing scripts from the database. If it exists a script for the customer for whom jobs are run, then it is used – otherwise municipality number 0 is retrieved, which is the default script.

The idea is that all customers should be run with the same script, but if a customer needs special runtime, e.g. because they lack data or have error data in their area, then you can put in a script that omits specific parts of the cube for that customer.

The Version field is not used by the SSIS package. It is purely for an easy reference when working in the table.

Versions of processing script files for earlier versions are under: E:\KMD\FLIS_AutoDeploy
![image.png](/.attachments/image-89b7fc86-6d26-4236-90d3-e81095aaaa0c.png)

path: /Teams/4. Support & Architecture/4.2 Guidelines/4.2.3 Install KMD modules from pdt teams without PAT
content:
We have currently large issues with downloadning from azure artifacts with PAT on out production and development server as the PAT expires very frequently and need manual refresh and intervention.
Thus we have creates a way where we can avoid this issue and continue with the portal without require downloads og the release via PAT.

### Step 1 Make a release

Release the module with modulebuilder as normal and then do the following:

### Step2 download artifact
Connect to 
https://dev.azure.com/kmd-dima/KMD.DIMA.LG/_artifacts/feed/KMD.DIMA.LG/

Hint Use 'Filter by keywords' to find the module and release version you want to install. 

When found click on the link on the name and copy the az command to download the module.

You will get a command like this 

`
az artifacts universal download --organization "https://dev.azure.com/kmd-dima/" 
--project "3fc38b6d-f815-45da-a219-357f03dbde03" --scope project --feed "KMD.DIMA.LG" 
--name "001_dataarea_bobrugsstat" --version "1.0.4" 
--path .  
`
change the path to modulename\versionnumber

like 

 `
az artifacts universal download --organization "https://dev.azure.com/kmd-dima/" 
--project "3fc38b6d-f815-45da-a219-357f03dbde03" --scope project --feed "KMD.DIMA.LG" 
--name "001_dataarea_bobrugsstat" --version "1.0.4"
 --path "001_dataarea_bobrugsstat\1.0.4"   ` **<<<<< changed path**


### What to do if it doesn't work
Use [https://laps.kmd.dk/Computer/AccessRequest]()  to Install powershell and az as local admin on your KMD PC
- install powershell via kmd software shop
- install az as described in here [https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/cli/azure/install-azure-cli-windows?tabs=azure-cli]()
- run az login and use your KMD login to get access 
- Continue from step 2 


### Step 3 
Copy the folder with the versionnumber to \\kdidmssdb01\install\modules\<MODULENAME>\<VERSIONNUMBER>
*note you need to be on the kmdpfosap domain before it is working.


[file://KDIDMSSDB01/install/modules]()

Notify PEY/TNH/JMB that a new release has been copied to the Share. They will continue with the installation

path: /Teams/4. Support & Architecture/4.2 Guidelines/4.2.5 Standard Software Installation
content:
### Standard Software installation
as per 2023-05-30
1. Install the following software (Installation files can be found on kdipmssdb01 under f:\kmd\installs):
- a.	TortoiseSvn (remember to include command line tools). **1.14.5.29465** 
- b.	IQ Client (install as administrator with install location “c:\sapiq”). Only choose to install SAP IQ ODBC in install set custom. **kmddbs0029**
- c.	Set c:\sapiq\jre\bin ind i PATH miljøvariablen. 
_Remember to restart MSSQL server service, it only reads the path when starting_
- d.	Notepad++ newest version and ComparePlugin.dll **8.5.3**
- e.	MySql ODBC driver  Install Mysql-connector-odbc-5.3.7-winx64 **5.3.7**
- f.	7-zip   **21.07**
- g.    WinSCP **6.1**
- h.	DB2 drivers: **(HUSK AT BESTILLE DRIVER PIETER /status møde hvordan bestiller vi det ?  )**
DB2 drivers is a part of IBM Data Server Client – DB2COPY1
Must be ordered in the server ordering -  lew@kmd.dk 
Licenses must be added to DB2 Connect - lew@kmd.dk
IP address must be whitelisted at DB2 – see SRITM0634494
Run below on the server to set up DB2 connection to BCDSNW
Run this command first from command prompt

- `db2cmd -i -w db2clpsetcp`

Then run the following commands


```
SET DB2_GRP_LOOKUP=LOCAL
DB2 UPDATE CLI CFG FOR SECTION COMMON USING QueryTimeOutInterval 0
db2 catalog tcpip node bcdsnwn  remote 195.50.39.130 server 5024 REMOTE_INSTANCE DB2 SYSTEM BCMVS   OSTYPE MVS
db2 catalog dcs database bcdsnw  as bcdsnw
db2 catalog db BCDSNW AS KMDDW at node bcdsnwn authentication DCS
DB2 CATALOG SYSTEM ODBC DATA SOURCE KMDDW
DB2 UPDATE CLI CFG FOR SECTION KMDDW USING  AUTOCOMMIT 1 CURSORHOLD 1 LOBMAXCOLUMNSIZE 1048575 LONGDATACOMPAT 1
```
Remember that you need to uncatalog, node dcs and db it isn’t enough to delete ODBC entry
Eksample of how to uncatalog.

```
db2 uncatalog node BCDSNPn
db2 uncatalog dcs db BCDSNP
db2 uncatalog db BCDSNP
```


In Linked Servers - > Providers – IBMADB”.DB2COPY1 go to properties and set check mark in “Allow inprocess”

Db2cmd
db2 list db directory
db2 list node directory

 - h.	Install XMLBULKLOAD (https://www.microsoft.com/en-us/download/details.aspx?id=30403) or KMDDBS2131 f:\kmd\install\sqlxml_x64.msi ** CHECK **
 - i.	Install MySql .Net connection software placed on KMDDBS2132 f:\kmd\install called mysql-connector-net-6.9.9

# Introduction 

The Architecture Office (AO) enables DIMA to develop a modern and sustainable data platform that reduces internal friction and meets requirements for both existing and new services.

---

## Responsibilities

AO takes ownership of discussions, improvements, innovation, prioritization, consistency, and knowledge sharing across several key areas:
*   **Framework, Tools, and Platform** – Ensuring best practices and alignment with company standards.
*   **Project Architecture** – Defining and maintaining architectural guidelines.
*   **Technology Roadmap** – Shaping the future direction of technological development.
*   **Security** – Ensuring compliance with security policies and best practices.

## Workflow

AO follows a structured seven-step cycle to manage ideas and implementation effectively:
1.  **Idea** – Initial concept development.
2.  **Maturation** – Refining and assessing feasibility.
3.  **Concept** – Defining the solution.
4.  **Prioritized Backlog** – Evaluating and gating projects for development.
5.  **Development** – Implementing the agreed-upon solution.
6.  **Implementation** – Deploying the solution.
7.  **Documentation and Communication** – Ensuring knowledge sharing and alignment.

AO collaborates closely with D&D, DevOps, ABD/BM, Sales and Customers to facilitate each stage of this cycle.

## Organizational Structure

AO acts as a backbone between key stakeholders, ensuring architectural consistency and alignment across multiple teams:
*   Supports Product Development Teams, PDT 3, PDT 4, PDT 5, etc.
*   Works alongside DevOps, ABD/BM, and Sales
*   Bridges the gap between KMD Data and Customers
This structure ensures a streamlined flow of architectural decisions, innovation, and best practices across the organization.

path: /Technology & Software/1. SAPBO/1.3 IDT (Information Design Tool)/1.3.7 Best Practice/Authorization
content:
All solutions must be able to handle row-based security. The ideal, of course, is if the subject system can provide information about this. If this is not the case, we have a solution where the customer themselves enter what the different users have the right to, so they can perform an update upon opening.

Security is handled via a filter which can either be mandatory or optional, where the users' rights are joined on the table, so that the SAP BO user determines what is possible to see for the end user.

![image.png](/.attachments/image-b1e73976-6c18-48d6-b8ce-1959cabeb7f6.png)
![image.png](/.attachments/image-447baff7-eacd-480e-ba0a-bae055943b6e.png)

If the filter is mandatory, it is placed on the folder that contains sensitive personal information, thereby ensuring that users never see anything other than what they have access to among the objects in the folder.

If the filter is optional, it allows the user to see data that they do not have access to, for example, benchmark numbers. In this case, it is the person who builds the report who must ensure that the filter is included if the report contains sensitive personal data.

path: /Technology & Software/1. SAPBO/1.3 IDT (Information Design Tool)/1.3.7 Best Practice/Objects
content:
**Dimension:** Essentially corresponds to a column in a table but can also represent a logical grouping. List of values (LOV) is associated with all dimension values, which are sorted in IDT.

**Dimension and Time**: It’s important for the universe to always include a date dimension. If the universe is month-based, the end of the month is used.

**Measures:** Used for calculations and counts.

**Details:** Not used.

**Filters:** Only dynamic time filters are used, allowing end-users to choose the reporting period.
Filters and Time:** In filters where dynamic time is calculated (e.g., current year), the time is based on the data source’s update date.

**Naming:** Objects are named according to domain syntax, starting with a capital letter followed by lowercase.

**Object Variants:** Typically, three variants of an object are created if it contains a key/code and a text:
Object name with number/code (e.g., Registration account number, Institution number, Absence reason code)
Object name (e.g., Registration account, Institution name)
Object number + object name (e.g., Long registration account, Long institution)

**Hierarchical Objects:** For hierarchical objects, the level is indicated in parentheses (e.g., H01, H02). Filters for hierarchies are placed at the bottom. See under Hierarchies.

path: /Technology & Software/1. SAPBO/1.3 IDT (Information Design Tool)/1.3.7 Best Practice/Test of Universe
content:
New universes must be approved by Brian (BFL) before they are put into operation.

Furthermore, the following tests must be carried out:

New universe:

Integrity test in Information Design Tool
Test that all objects work
Test of formatting of the objects
Test of performance. A query should not take longer than necessary
Introduction of aggregate table if the solution has a large granularity, so we can ensure performance over time and on very detailed reports
Are there long text strings that should be shortened by default (backend)?
Test of the solution’s metrics - does it calculate correctly? It is important that there is also a sum down on the select statement
Test that there is an aggregation function on metrics
![image.png](/.attachments/image-921d6b01-431f-47b5-ac90-ae89d0df21b1.png)  
Naming must follow the standards described and in the master objects
Test reports must be built under the 010 folder with historical data, so data can be validated in connection with new releases
![image.png](/.attachments/image-36a9465e-7324-4e1e-b083-13071eebf458.png)
Test of row-based security - the solution must contain a possibility for row-based security
Predefined filters where it makes sense
Existing universe after release:

Use of reports with “locked” values. Does it still show the same?
Test of performance
